review_scope: All translation keys checked by the content auditor; all ten English and localized titles, flagged source/target pairs, and two deterministic long-passage samples reviewed. Currency insertions in numeric examples and escaped markup checked separately.

corrections.source: Now imagine that the seller applies a five-pack price tier. That changes the comparison because one of the inputs has moved. A spreadsheet formula that extrapolated the four-pack comparison would miss it. Write the observed totals for one, three, four and five packs as separate scenarios, with the exact option used in each. Keep the marketplace address beside each result. A shop's price for a short pack of socks is no evidence about the price of a longer pack, even when the picture shows the same colour assortment.
corrections.translation: 5パックから別の単価が適用されるなら、4パックの計算を延長しても正しい比較にはなりません。1、3、4、5パックのそれぞれで決済画面を開き、選択した仕様、表示総額、元の商品ページのURLを別々に控えてください。配色の写真が同じでも、短い靴下の料金から丈の長い靴下の価格を推定することはできません。

corrections.source: If a second credit of 6 appears later, record it on the date it posts and retain its reference. Your final net becomes 71. Do not retroactively change the original 12 to 6 and also include the six-unit credit; that would reduce your ledger twice. In a group order, decide whether a changed charge requires a revised split. The person who cancelled may still have agreed to share domestic delivery. That is a settlement choice among buyers and separate from the seller's accounting.
corrections.translation: 後日さらに6が返金されたら、入金日と取引番号を別の行に記録します。最終的な支出は71です。当初の送料12を後から6に書き換えたうえで返金6を差し引くと、二重に引いてしまいます。共同購入なら、負担の分け方も変更するか相談してください。キャンセルした人が国内送料を負担する約束だった可能性もあります。仲間内での精算と出品者の請求は別の記録です。

corrections.source: Conversely, a service can appear in a list of selected options and again in a payment summary because the summary repeats its components. Compare the amount due with and without the charge included once. If including it once already reproduces the payment, the second display is probably a different view of the same amount. State what your arithmetic demonstrates and leave the internal accounting explanation to the provider. The goal is to identify a real mismatch, not to infer a duplicate from typography.
corrections.translation: 選択したサービスが、選択肢一覧と支払いの内訳の両方に表示されることがあります。まずその料金を除いて足し、次に1回だけ足してみてください。1回加えたところで支払額と一致すれば、同じ料金を別の画面で示している可能性があります。算出できた合計を窓口に示し、内部の計上方法は事業者に確認します。表記が2か所あるだけでは、二重請求とは判断できません。

corrections.source: Suppose the confirmed unit prices are 80, 94 and 80 yuan and the order has one 9-yuan domestic charge. The merchandise total is 254 and the order total is 263. If the payment request shows 269, inspect its components before calling the extra six a service charge. The seller may have changed the price of one variant, added an explicit charge or applied a different quantity. Compare each option, quantity and line subtotal in order. A three-line purchase is small enough to reconcile without guessing which part changed.
corrections.translation: 商品が80元、94元、80元で、注文全体の中国国内送料が9元なら、商品小計は254元、合計は263元です。支払請求が269元なら、差額6元を手数料と決めつける前に、各行の内訳を見てください。特定の仕様の値段、個数、明示された追加料金のいずれかが変わったかもしれません。3行の仕様、個数、小計を順に照合すれば、差の出所を確認できます。

corrections.source: A second shop offers a pair of plain socks individually or as a five-pair pack. Four single pairs at 12 each cost 48. A five-pair pack at 55 costs 11 per pair, yet requires a larger outlay and leaves an extra pair. The cheaper per-pair price does not automatically answer which option suits a buyer who needs exactly four. Compare both the total cash required and the number of useful units that will actually be used.
corrections.translation: 別の店では無地の靴下が1足ずつ、または5足セットで売られています。1足12なら4足で48。5足セットは55で1足当たり11ですが、支払いは増えて1足余ります。ちょうど4足必要な人には、単価の低さだけではどちらがよいか決まりません。実際の支払額と使う足数の両方を比べてください。

corrections.source: Keep the old quote and add a revised quote under it. If the larger amount was already paid, track the credit process separately from the recalculated cost. Do not enter 202 as the only payment when the account shows 274 collected and a credit still pending. The two records answer different questions: what the retained merchandise should cost, and which funds have actually moved. Keep the same line names so that a friend reviewing the change can tell which item became unavailable.
corrections.translation: 元の見積もりを残し、その下に修正版を追加します。すでに274を支払って返金待ちなら、残る商品の価格が202になっても、支払い履歴を202だけに置き換えないでください。残る商品の代金と実際のお金の出入りは別々に追います。各行の品名を維持すれば、共同購入者にもどの商品が欠品になったか伝わります。

corrections.source: Imagine you have chosen a coat from one shop, a scarf from another and two bags from a third. The coat is received first. The scarf seller confirms the original colour is unavailable, and the bag seller sends two domestic tracking numbers. On your sheet you now have one ready item, one unresolved purchase and two shipments linked to one purchase. Listing all four items as ready would result in a parcel plan the warehouse cannot yet fulfill.
corrections.translation: 3店舗からコート1着、マフラー1本、バッグ2個をそれぞれ購入したとします。コートは入庫済み、マフラーは希望色が欠品、バッグの店からは国内追跡番号が2件届きました。表には、発送に回せる品物が1点、未解決の購入が1件、同じ購入に紐づく配送が2件と記録します。4点とも準備完了と書くと、倉庫がまだ実行できない梱包計画になってしまいます。

corrections.source: Work out two possible shopping baskets. In the first, the scarf is cancelled and the coat and both bags are retained. In the second, you accept a different scarf and wait for its arrival. Show confirmed costs shared by both scenarios once and note the costs and risks that differ. The first option may change freight by removing an item; the second may change warehouse timing. Neither estimate is complete until you have the measurements and services for the parcel you actually intend to submit.
corrections.translation: マフラーをキャンセルしてコートとバッグ2個だけ送る案と、別の色のマフラーを受け入れて入庫を待つ案を比べます。両案に共通する確定額は1回だけ書き、それぞれで変わる費用と条件を記録してください。前者は中身の減少で送料が変わり、後者は発送までの待ち時間が変わります。実際に出す荷物の寸法とサービスが決まるまでは、どちらも概算です。

corrections.source: Take a fictional payment in which the base amount is 300 yuan and the comparison rate is 7.50 yuan per home-currency unit. The base conversion gives 40.00. One hypothetical payment method adds a fixed fee of 1.30 home units. Another has no fixed fee but quotes a conversion that results in 41.00. For this amount, the second method would cost 0.30 less, provided both figures are final and cover the same goods and services. The lower quoted exchange figure alone does not determine the result.
corrections.translation: 仮に代金が300元で、比較に使うレートを自分の通貨1単位当たり7.50元とすると、換算額は40.00です。支払方法Aには自分の通貨で1.30の定額手数料が付きます。方法Bには定額手数料がありませんが、提示レートでは41.00になります。同じ商品・サービスに対する確定額なら、Bのほうが0.30安くなります。レートの数字だけで判断せず、手数料込みの総額を比較します。

corrections.source: Now change the purchase to 75 yuan using the same illustrative conditions. The first method gives 10.00 plus 1.30, while an equally sized percentage difference on the second method might have a very different effect in absolute terms. Recalculate instead of assuming the method that won on the first purchase also wins here. Fixed fees matter proportionally more on small payments. These invented numbers explain comparison mechanics only and make no claim about the methods, rates or fees offered to any HubBuy account.
corrections.translation: 同じ条件で代金を75元にすると、最初の支払方法の負担は10.00に定額手数料1.30を足した額になります。一方の方法のレート差が同じ割合でも、金額の差は変わります。少額決済では定額手数料の比率が高くなるので、前回安かった方法が今回も安いとは限りません。これは比較方法を説明する架空の例で、HubBuyの決済手段や実際の手数料を示すものではありません。

corrections.source: For a parcel, keep packed measurements and route consistent as well. If the first screenshot was a quick estimate for one jacket and the second a final all-in payment for a larger consolidated package, no exchange-rate calculation can make them a fair pair. Mark the physical change first. If useful, obtain a new estimate for the same parcel inputs in the current display currency and state its date. An old figure can explain the history even when it cannot answer the present comparison.
corrections.translation: 荷物の比較では梱包後の寸法と配送方法もそろえます。最初の画面が上着1着の簡易見積もりで、次の画面が複数商品をまとめた大箱の最終請求なら、換算だけで公平な比較にはできません。まず物理的な変更点を記録します。必要なら現在の表示通貨で同条件の見積もりを取り直し、日付も残してください。古い数字は現在の価格比較には使えなくても、経緯の説明には役立ちます。

corrections.source: Sometimes a buyer needs a planning figure before the exact transaction rate is known. Show a sensitivity range using clearly labelled hypothetical rates instead of presenting a single amount as guaranteed. For a 450-yuan amount, 7.50 yuan per home unit produces 60.00, while 7.20 produces 62.50, before any additional charges. That 2.50 spread identifies how much the assumption matters for this hypothetical budget. It does not predict the rate available at checkout.
corrections.translation: 決済時のレートが不明なら、仮定を明記して予算の幅を出します。450元は、自分の通貨1単位当たり7.50元なら60.00単位、7.20元なら62.50単位です。いずれも追加手数料を含みません。差の2.50は仮定が予算に及ぼす影響であり、決済画面で使えるレートの予測ではありません。

corrections.source: A service can change the parcel twice: once through its own price and again through its effect on the finished box. Capture those effects separately before choosing how to pack.
corrections.translation: 梱包サービスを追加すると、サービス自体の料金に加え、仕上がった箱の寸法や重量が変わって送料にも影響することがあります。梱包方法を決める前に両方の影響を別々に記録してください。

corrections.source: Some buyers compare packing by dividing the invoice by the scale weight. A heavier but better protected version may appear cheaper per kilogram even though it costs more overall. Conversely, a lighter parcel with a larger outer box may cost more on a route that considers volume. Use the total charge for the parcel that actually fulfills your requirements. Keep a per-kilogram calculation only when it helps answer a secondary comparison.
corrections.translation: 請求額を実測重量で割ると、保護を増やして重量と総額が上がった案でも、1 kg当たりでは安く見えることがあります。反対に、軽くても外箱が大きいと、容積を考慮する配送方法では高くなる場合があります。判断の基準は必要な保護条件を満たす荷物の総額です。重量当たりの価格は、別の比較に必要なときに使ってください。

corrections.source: Consider a fictional box costing 150 at 2 kg and another costing 160 at 2.5 kg. Their apparent costs per kilogram are 75 and 64. The lower unit figure belongs to the more expensive parcel. It may still be the better choice if the extra protective materials serve a real need, but the numerical ratio alone cannot settle that. A buyer evaluating whether to add protection should instead look at the incremental ten, the change in dimensions and the value of preserving the required condition.
corrections.translation: 仮に2 kgの箱の料金が150、2.5 kgの箱が160なら、1 kg当たりは75と64です。単価が低い後者のほうが総額は高くなります。追加の保護が必要なら後者が適する場合もありますが、比率だけでは判断できません。追加負担の10、外寸の変化、必要な状態で届けることの価値を一緒に検討します。

corrections.source: Write down its contents and whether retail boxes and extra protection are included. Measure the outer package that would travel, not the folded garment or its original product box alone. If you only have measurements supplied by a seller, label them accordingly. HubBuy's estimator offers approximate product presets as starting points and also accepts manual information. Use the more specific measurement when it genuinely describes your parcel.
corrections.translation: 中身と、商品の元箱や追加保護材を入れるかを記録します。測るのは実際に送る外箱で、畳んだ服や商品単体の箱だけではありません。出品者が示した寸法しかない場合はその旨を書きます。HubBuyの見積もりには商品別の参考値があり、数値の手入力もできます。実際の荷物を測った値があればそちらを優先してください。

corrections.source: A hypothetical box measuring 40 by 30 by 20 centimetres has an outer rectangular volume of 24,000 cubic centimetres. A second box measuring 40 by 30 by 15 has 18,000. The reduced height removes a quarter of that geometric volume. Whether it changes freight depends on the chosen route's limits and billing rules, which must be checked on the actual offer. Avoid assigning a general dimensional divisor to every route.
corrections.translation: 仮に外寸が40 × 30 × 20 cmの箱なら、直方体としての体積は24,000 cm³です。40 × 30 × 15 cmなら18,000 cm³で、高さを5 cm減らすと体積は4分の1減ります。送料も下がるかは配送方法のサイズ制限と計算規則によります。すべての配送方法に同じ容積重量の除数を当てはめず、実際の条件を確認します。

corrections.source: Take an example of an empty carton whose inside is labelled 35 by 25 by 15 centimetres. After loading it and applying protection, the outside measures 36 by 26 by 17. The inside rectangular volume is 13,125 cubic centimetres. The outside rectangular volume is 15,912, a difference of 2,787. This discrepancy can arise without adding a second product. The box walls, the lid and a bulging section can all matter to the outer measurement.
corrections.translation: 空箱の内寸が35 × 25 × 15 cmで、商品と保護材を入れた後の外寸が36 × 26 × 17 cmだとします。直方体としての内側の体積は13,125 cm³、外側は15,912 cm³で、その差は2787 cm³です。商品をもう1点入れなくても、箱の厚みやふた、膨らんだ部分で外寸は変わります。

corrections.source: A warehouse message might give 17 centimetres for height while an older seller diagram showed 14. Before asking which figure is wrong, identify what each person measured. The diagram could refer to the product, a folded product, an inner carton or the package before reinforcement. Ask for the outer parcel reference and the time of measurement. A difference can be completely reasonable when the objects measured are different.
corrections.translation: 倉庫から高さ17 cmと連絡が来たのに、古い出品者の図には14 cmとある場合、まず双方の測定対象を確認します。図が示すのは商品、畳んだ商品、内箱、補強前の箱のいずれかかもしれません。外箱の識別番号と測定時点を確認してください。測った物が違えば、どちらの数字も妥当なことがあります。

corrections.source: If both records supposedly refer to the same finished parcel, compare the orientation and endpoints. A tape starting at the bottom edge of a recessed panel and ending at the centre of a flat lid may miss protected corners that project farther. Ask for the longest outside span rather than the measurement across the central panel. Keep a generous uncertainty in a planning figure when the parcel sits close to an eligibility limit. Final acceptance depends on the carrier and the route's actual rule.
corrections.translation: 同じ完成済みの箱を測った数値なら、メジャーを当てた向きと両端を確認します。へこんだ側面の下端からふたの中央までを測ると、突き出たコーナーガードが計測から漏れる可能性があります。中央の板の幅ではなく、いちばん外側にある2点の間を測ってもらってください。上限に近いときは見積もりに余裕を持たせます。最終的な引き受けは配送会社と利用経路の条件によります。

corrections.source: Attach a short contents description to each measurement set. For example, record that the photograph shows the parcel containing the jacket and both accessory cases after corner protection was added. If an item is removed the following day, create another record rather than overwriting the first. When the final statement differs from the initial estimate, you can then identify whether the difference belongs to a changed route, a changed parcel or a changed pricing input.
corrections.translation: 各測定結果に内容物のメモを付けます。例えば「ジャケットとアクセサリーケース2個を入れ、角を保護した後の写真」と書きます。翌日品物を取り出したら、以前の記録を上書きせず新しい行を作ります。最終請求額が初回の見積もりと違うとき、変わったのが配送方法、荷物の作り方、料金計算の条件のどれかをたどれます。

corrections.source: Suppose the combined option in a worked example is quoted at 164 units. The split option has one box quoted at 105 and a second at 72. The split total is 177 before any separately listed packing services. Looking only at the 105 would reverse the result. Add optional charges that apply twice and remove any charge shown as already included. Record the currency and timestamp for all quotations.
corrections.translation: 同梱の見積もりが164、別送の箱が105と72なら、別送は別途表示の梱包料金を加える前で合計177です。105だけを比べると結論が逆になります。箱ごとに必要な追加サービスはそれぞれ加え、すでに含まれている料金は重複させないでください。すべての見積もりについて、通貨と取得日時を記録します。

corrections.source: A second address changes the question
corrections.translation: 送り先が2か所なら比較条件も変わる

corrections.source: A single initial estimate might turn into two shipments after an item is delayed. Compare their combined final cost with the original estimate only after identifying what changed. For example, two final parcels costing 88 and 76 have a combined cost of 164. Comparing only the 88 with the original estimate would leave the second box out; comparing each final box independently with the entire original estimate would count the same baseline twice.
corrections.translation: 当初は1個口の予定でも、1点の入庫が遅れて2個に分ける場合があります。変更点を記録してから2個の実費の合計を元の予算と比較します。例えば料金が88と76なら、実際の合計は164です。88だけでは2箱目が抜けますが、それぞれの箱を同じ当初予算全額と比べれば、基準額を2回使うことになります。

corrections.source: A seller may display several quantity tiers. Read whether quantities can be mixed across colours and whether the minimum is per style or total. For a hypothetical offer priced at 55 per piece for four or more, a basket of three may still use the lower-volume price. Count complete selling units. Two pairs in a two-pair pack can be one selling unit even though the warehouse receives four individual articles.
corrections.translation: 出品者によっては購入数量で単価が変わります。色の異なる商品を合算できるか、最低数が仕様別か注文全体かを確認します。仮に4販売単位以上で単価55となる条件なら、3単位では少量用の価格のままかもしれません。数えるのは販売単位です。2足セットは倉庫に左右あわせて4点届いても、販売上は1セットとなり得ます。

corrections.source: Measure length, width and height perpendicular to each other, including protruding parts of the packaging. Do not use the interior dimensions printed on an empty carton when a packed lid bulges. Place the package on a stable surface. If asking someone else to measure, request centimetres, the outside of the sealed parcel and a note identifying which box they measured. Save the figures with the parcel reference.
corrections.translation: 縦・横・高さは互いに直角の方向で測り、突き出た保護材や膨らみも含めます。ふたが盛り上がった状態なら、空箱に印刷された内寸は使えません。箱は安定した台に置きます。依頼するときは「封をした外箱の外寸をcmで」と書き、どの箱かを指定してください。測定値は荷物番号と一緒に保存します。

corrections.source: Suppose each smaller box also needs an explicitly quoted service costing five, while the combined option already includes it. The separate total becomes 216, two more than the combined quote. Such a narrow difference may be less important than arrival timing or how easily a recipient can receive two packages. Record the non-price reason for any choice so that a later invoice comparison is not mistaken for proof that the earlier decision was irrational.
corrections.translation: 小さい箱ごとに料金5の追加サービスが必要で、同梱案にはすでに含まれているとします。別送の総額は216となり、同梱の見積もりを2上回ります。これほど小さな差なら、到着時期や受取人が2箱を受け取れるかのほうが重要な場合があります。価格以外の理由も記録しておくと、後の金額比較だけで当初の判断を評価せずに済みます。

corrections.source: Consider a fictional comparison for a buyer sending two hoodies and one rigid accessory case to the same address. The buyer wants the case protected and both hoodies included. Assume the offered combined arrangement costs 185 inclusive of the necessary protection. One separate parcel for the hoodies costs 102 and a second protected parcel for the case costs 96. Their sum is 198. On these particular assumptions the single-box option costs 13 less and satisfies the stated requirements.
corrections.translation: 2着のパーカーと硬いアクセサリーケースを同じ住所に送り、ケースには保護が必要とします。架空の見積もりで、必要な保護込みの同梱は185。別送ならパーカーが102、保護したケースが96で合計198です。この条件では同梱でも必要な品物と保護がそろい、金額は13少なくなります。13は198から185を引いた差額です。

corrections.translation: 簡易見積もりに表示される重量は、購入した商品の実測値ですか？

corrections.source: HubBuy labels its quick-estimate examples as approximate. Use them while planning, then replace them with measured figures from your own order and its intended packing.
corrections.translation: HubBuyの簡易見積もりにある数値は目安です。予算を立てる際の仮の値として使い、実測できたら予定どおりに梱包した荷物の重量に差し替えます。

corrections.source: Why does the estimate ask for dimensions as well as weight?
corrections.translation: 送料の見積もりに、重量だけでなく寸法も必要なのはなぜですか？

corrections.source: A route can have size limits or consider parcel volume when billing. Enter the actual outer length, width and height when you have them, and read the terms for the route you select.
corrections.translation: 配送方法によってはサイズ制限があり、容積に応じて料金が決まることもあります。最終的な外箱の縦・横・高さを入力し、候補となる配送方法の条件を確認してください。

corrections.source: What does seller-to-warehouse delivery pay for?
corrections.translation: 出品者から倉庫までの送料は、どの区間のものですか？

corrections.source: It covers the domestic movement from the seller to the receiving warehouse when such a charge applies. HubBuy lists the product purchase and China shipping before the later international parcel stage.
corrections.translation: この料金がかかる場合、対象は出品者から受け取り倉庫までの中国国内配送です。HubBuyの手順でも、商品の購入と国内配送は国際発送より前の段階です。明細は区間別に確認します。

corrections.source: How should I budget two items from the same seller?
corrections.translation: 同じ出品者から2点購入するとき、中国国内送料はどう計算しますか？

corrections.source: Read the final seller order summary to see whether domestic shipping is charged once or per item. Keep that amount on the seller order and allocate it only if you need per-item costs.
corrections.translation: 出品者の注文確定時の明細を見て、1注文ごとの料金か、商品ごとの料金かを確かめます。実際の国内送料をその注文に記録し、商品別の原価が必要な場合に限って配分します。

corrections.source: Can I assume separate sellers share one domestic charge?
corrections.translation: 複数の出品者から買えば、中国国内送料もまとめられますか？

corrections.source: Keep a separate purchase record for each seller. Even when purchases later travel abroad together, the domestic deliveries may have separate charges and separate tracking numbers.
corrections.translation: 出品者ごとに注文を記録してください。後から1個の国際小包にまとめても、倉庫に届くまでは送料も追跡番号も別々の場合があります。

corrections.source: When should I use a packed weight rather than the seller's item weight?
corrections.translation: 商品単体の重量を梱包後の重量に置き換えるのはいつですか？

corrections.source: Use the packed figure for the international parcel estimate once available. It includes the box and packing materials, whereas a seller's product figure may refer only to the unit.
corrections.translation: 国際送料を見積もる際、梱包後の実測値があればそちらを使います。外箱や緩衝材の重さも含まれます。出品者の表示は商品だけの重さかもしれません。

corrections.source: How do I convert kilograms for the HubBuy calculator?
corrections.translation: HubBuyの送料計算で、kgをgに換算するにはどうしますか？

corrections.source: Multiply kilograms by 1,000 to enter grams. A parcel measured at 1.35 kg is 1,350 g. Keep length, width and height in centimetres on the same worksheet.
corrections.translation: kg表示の数値を1000倍します。例えば1.35 kgの荷物は1350 gと入力します。同じ記録に書く縦・横・高さの単位はcmです。

corrections.source: Can I add three product lengths to obtain my parcel length?
corrections.translation: 3点の商品の長さを足せば、梱包後の長さになりますか？

corrections.source: Only if the items will actually be packed end to end. Decide on the proposed arrangement and measure its outer envelope. Leave room for protective material and confirm packed dimensions later.
corrections.translation: 3点を一直線に並べて梱包する場合に限ります。実際の配置で全体の外側を測り、緩衝材のスペースを考慮したうえで、最後に外箱の寸法を確認します。

corrections.source: How do I compare a single box with two boxes?
corrections.translation: 大きな箱1個と小さな箱2個のどちらが安いか、どう比べますか？

corrections.source: Request or calculate each option using the same items, destination and protection requirements. Compare the combined charge for both smaller parcels with the charge for the single larger parcel.
corrections.translation: 中身、配送先、必要な保護をそろえて、それぞれ見積もります。2個に分ける案では、両方の料金を足してから1個の案と比較してください。

corrections.source: Why should I keep the quote currency beside the amount?
corrections.translation: 見積金額と一緒に通貨も記録するのはなぜですか？

corrections.source: A number without its currency is ambiguous. Record the currency code at quotation and at payment, along with any conversion rate and fee shown, before comparing two totals.
corrections.translation: 数字だけでは金額の価値を比較できません。見積もりの通貨、決済通貨、支払い明細に表示された為替レートや手数料を控えてから、合計を比較します。

corrections.source: How should an optional packing charge be recorded?
corrections.translation: 追加の梱包サービスはどう記録しますか？

corrections.source: Write down the exact service, amount and whether it applies to an item or parcel. Check if a quoted total already includes it before adding it separately.
corrections.translation: サービス名、金額、商品単位か荷物単位かを記録します。別途加算する前に、見積もりの合計に含まれていないかを確かめてください。

corrections.source: Is the cheapest displayed route suitable for every parcel?
corrections.translation: 画面に出た最安の配送方法は、すべての荷物に使えますか？

corrections.source: Check destination coverage, size limits and acceptance of your actual contents. Compare delivery estimates and included services only among routes available for that parcel.
corrections.translation: 配送先、サイズ上限、品物の引き受け条件を確認してください。条件を満たす候補に絞ってから、所要日数の目安と料金に含まれるサービスを比べます。

corrections.source: What if I change the packing after obtaining a quote?
corrections.translation: 見積もり後に梱包を変えたらどうしますか？

corrections.source: Record what changed and rerun the estimate using the revised outer dimensions and weight. Keep the old result as a reference instead of presenting it as a quote for the new parcel.
corrections.translation: 変更点を記録し、新しい外寸と重量で再度見積もります。元の金額は比較用に残せますが、新しい荷物の料金としては扱えません。

corrections.source: Can I compare a product price converted by the spreadsheet directly with my card charge?
corrections.translation: 商品一覧の換算価格とカードの引き落とし額を直接比較できますか？

corrections.source: Start with the source amount, selected option and quantity. Compare conversion rate, charged currency and any explicitly listed fee on the payment record. The catalogue display is a browsing reference.
corrections.translation: まず元の通貨建ての価格、選んだ仕様、数量を合わせます。そのうえで決済通貨、適用レート、明示された手数料を支払い明細で確認してください。一覧の換算額は閲覧時の目安です。

corrections.source: Where does a seller discount belong in the budget?
corrections.translation: 出品者の割引はどこに記録しますか？

corrections.source: Record it beside the purchase to which it applies. Keep any outbound parcel discount separate, and check the conditions before subtracting a promotion from a planning estimate.
corrections.translation: 割引の対象となった購入項目に記録します。国際送料の割引は別にし、適用条件を確認してから予算に反映します。

corrections.source: Why does the final total differ from my first estimate?
corrections.translation: 最終金額が最初の見積もりと違うのはなぜですか？

corrections.source: Compare destination, contents, route, weight, dimensions, currency, packing, discounts and service entries. Identify the first difference you can document before asking about the remaining balance.
corrections.translation: 配送先、中身、配送方法、重量、寸法、通貨、梱包、割引、追加サービスを順に照合します。記録で説明できる差額を特定してから、残った差額について問い合わせると確認しやすくなります。

corrections.source: What should I save if a support question concerns two parcels?
corrections.translation: 荷物2個の料金について問い合わせるとき、何を残しておきますか？

corrections.source: Save both outbound parcel references, their item lists and their final charge statements. Mark the line you are comparing on each record so the question stays tied to the correct parcel.
corrections.translation: 両方の国際小包の番号、それぞれの内容品一覧、最終明細を保存します。どの荷物のどの項目を比べたいか、各明細に印を付けてください。

corrections.source: Can a warehouse item photo show the final packing dimensions?
corrections.translation: 倉庫の商品写真で、最終的な荷物の寸法が分かりますか？

corrections.source: An image of the product can help identify it, but the final dimensions refer to the sealed outer parcel. Ask for the packed measurements if the decision depends on fitting a route limit.
corrections.translation: 商品写真は中身の確認に役立ちます。配送に使う寸法は箱を閉じた後の外寸です。サイズ上限が配送方法の選択を左右するなら、梱包後の実測値を依頼してください。

corrections.source: What if my order contains a fragile accessory and soft clothing?
corrections.translation: 壊れやすい付属品と柔らかい衣類を同時に買ったときは、どう梱包を選びますか？

corrections.source: Ask which protective arrangement is available and whether the accessory requires a separate inner box. Compare combined and separate packing after allowing for that space.
corrections.translation: まず利用できる保護方法と、付属品専用の内箱が必要かを確認します。その分のスペースを含めて、同梱と別送の見積もりを比べてください。

corrections.source: Which support site matches the HubBuy links on this grid?
corrections.translation: この商品一覧で案内しているHubBuyの問い合わせ先はどこですか？

corrections.source: The purchase links on this grid lead to hubbuy.com. Use that site's current estimator, service information and customer support for a HubBuy quote or order-specific question.
corrections.translation: 当サイトの購入リンクはhubbuy.comに移動します。見積もりや個別の注文については、同サイトの最新の送料見積もり、サービス案内、問い合わせ窓口をご利用ください。

corrections.source: Work through a quotation with mixed units
corrections.translation: 異なる単位の料金を合計する

corrections.source: Read the quote in the state in which you intend to purchase it. A checkbox with a price beside it describes a possible selection. A selected checkbox and corresponding subtotal tell you more. Record the initial base, activate the desired service and compare the new amount, currency and named lines. Keep a note if the price display already bundles the service. Adding the visible price again outside the quote would inflate the apparent cost.
corrections.translation: 実際に購入予定の状態で見積もりを読みます。未選択のチェック欄の横の金額は、選べるサービスの価格です。まず基本額を控え、希望サービスを選び、通貨、明細、更新後の合計を比べます。すでに組み込み済みならその旨をメモしてください。表示総額に同じ作業の値段を再度加えると費用を過大に見積もります。

corrections.source: Read an adjustment without erasing the original quote
corrections.translation: 元の見積もりを残して変更を追う

corrections.source: Use separate rows for quoted, paid and credited amounts. If a charge was removed, enter the credit with its reference. When a final invoice rolls services into a parcel subtotal, place that subtotal in a comparison column rather than adding it to the detailed entries. Check that your reconstructed total agrees with the payment record within ordinary rounding. Write down the remaining difference and ask support which invoice line explains it.
corrections.translation: 見積額、支払額、返金額を別の行に記録します。料金が取り消されたら、返金と取引番号を記入してください。最終明細で各サービスが小包の小計にまとまった場合、小計は照合用の欄に置き、詳細行の上にもう一度足さないようにします。通常の端数を考慮しても支払額と合わなければ、残る差額を示して対応する請求項目を尋ねます。

corrections.source: The service description should tell you what will be done to the object. A request to protect a bag could mean filling its interior to retain shape, keeping its original box or placing it in a larger outer carton. Each choice may affect the parcel differently. Specify the object, the result you need and any condition such as keeping detachable handles together. Then read what the selected service actually promises. If it covers only an outer carton, do not count it as individual protection for every item inside.
corrections.translation: 「かばんを保護」には、中に詰め物をして形を保つ、元箱を残す、より大きな外箱に入れるなど複数の方法があります。何をどのような状態にしたいか、着脱式の持ち手も一緒にするかを伝え、選んだサービスが何を約束しているか読みます。外箱の補強しか含まれていないなら、中身全点の個別包装まで付くとは考えないでください。

corrections.source: If the request changes, keep the first quotation and add the new one. Record which service was removed and whether its replacement has a different unit. Consider replacing one outer-box option costing ten with individual protection costing four for each of three units. The new selected services total twelve, a difference of two. Adding twelve to the old ten would describe buying both alternatives, which was never the instruction. A dated note beside each version helps later if the two appear in separate account messages.
corrections.translation: 要望を変えたら最初の見積もりを残し、取り消したサービスと新しい料金単位を記録します。外箱一式10の作業から、3点を1点4で個別保護する作業に変えると、新料金は12、差額は2です。古い10と新しい12を両方足すと、頼んでいない両方の作業を購入した計算になります。各版に日付を入れておくと、異なる確認メッセージとも照合できます。

corrections.source: Begin with the parcel reference, currency and exact service label. State the amount you can reconcile and the remaining difference. For instance: my summary shows two wraps at three each and a carton at nine, totalling fifteen; my service subtotal is eighteen; please identify the remaining three. Add the relevant quote date and a cropped image of the service lines if necessary. Exclude unrelated orders and personal payment details. One concrete arithmetic question gives support a practical starting point.
corrections.translation: 小包番号、通貨、サービスの正確な表示名から始めます。「個別包装が2点で各3、外箱が9なので計15です。サービス小計は18ですが、残りの3は何の料金ですか」と書くと、差額が明確です。必要なら見積日と該当する明細部分の画像を添え、関係ない注文や支払い情報は伏せてください。

corrections.source: A catalogue conversion helps with browsing. A merchant quotation shows an amount offered in a particular currency. A card statement shows what was actually posted. Write which of those three you have beside every number. Do not replace the source currency when you translate a quote into your home currency. Keep the original information available so you can recalculate later without relying on a rounded display.
corrections.translation: 商品一覧の換算価格は閲覧時の目安、店の見積もりは特定通貨での提示額、カード明細は実際の記帳額です。各金額にどの資料の数字かを書きます。自分の通貨に換算しても、元の金額と通貨は残してください。丸められた画面表示に頼らず後で計算し直せます。

corrections.source: Imagine a teaching example in which one home-currency unit buys 7.20 yuan. A 360-yuan quote corresponds to 50 units before fees because 360 is divided by 7.20. If you instead record the rate as home units per yuan, multiply by that number. Write out both currency codes with the rate. A single bare value such as 7.20 is especially easy to use backwards when a sheet mixes several quotations.
corrections.translation: 仮に自分の通貨1単位で7.20元を買えるなら、360元の見積もりは手数料前で50単位です。360を7.20で割ります。「1元当たり自分の通貨で何単位か」と逆に記録した場合は、その値を掛けます。レートの両側に通貨コードを書きましょう。複数の見積もりがある表で「7.20」とだけ書くと、向きを取り違えやすくなります。

corrections.source: Suppose quote A covers the same merchandise and domestic delivery as quote B, but only A includes protective packing. Compare the contents before worrying about exchange-rate rounding. Either add the confirmed packing amount to B or label the quotes as different offers. If a missing charge has no confirmed amount, leave a gap instead of filling it with an attractive guess. A conversion cannot repair two quotes that describe different services.
corrections.translation: AとBが同じ商品と国内送料を含み、保護包装が入るのはAだけだとします。端数の違いより先に、Bに確認済みの保護料を足すか、異なるサービス一式の見積もりだと明記します。未確認額は空欄に状態を添え、都合のよい仮の価格で埋めないでください。通貨換算をしても、サービスの違いは消えません。

corrections.source: Before accepting a number from a screenshot, identify the currency code and whether the price covers one unit, the selected quantity or the entire parcel. Save any quoted conversion alongside the original amount. Someone reviewing the purchase later should be able to reproduce the converted value using those saved inputs, even after the currency selector displays a different rate.
corrections.translation: 通貨コードと、金額が1点分、選んだ数量分、または荷物全体のどれかを確認します。提示された換算額も元の金額の横に保存してください。後日通貨表示のレートが変わっても、残した条件で当時の換算額を再現できるようにします。

corrections.source: Suppose a hypothetical quote rises from 150 to 166 after a service is selected. If the service itself is listed at 10 and the packing changes the freight line by 6, record both changes. If the quote shows only an all-in increase of 16, report that observed difference and leave its composition unresolved. Do not present the whole 16 as the service fee or add the visible 10 on top of the already updated total.
corrections.translation: 仮にサービス選択後に見積もりが150から166になったとします。サービス自体が10で、梱包が変わって運賃が6上がったと分かれば、両方を記録します。総額が16上がったことしか分からない場合は、その差だけを示し内訳は未確認としておきます。16すべてをサービス料としたり、更新済みの166に10をさらに足したりしないでください。

corrections.source: Comparing two versions of a mixed parcel
corrections.translation: 複数の商品を同梱する2案を比較する

corrections.source: Keep the final parcel statement next to your selected services and measured outer dimensions. If the outbound charge changes, compare the final dimensions with the size assumed earlier. If the invoice shows an additional service, identify which piece and which instruction it corresponds to. If there is no clear match, ask support to explain the line and supply the quote you were comparing.
corrections.translation: 確定明細と選んだサービス、実測外寸を一緒に保存します。国際運賃が変われば、当初の想定寸法と比べます。新たな作業料があれば、どの商品についての何の指示かを特定します。対応が分からなければ、比較していた見積もりを示してその明細行の説明を求めます。

corrections.source: At receipt, preserve photographs of the box and its internal arrangement if you need to report a problem. Document the visible condition; a photograph cannot establish where along the journey an impact occurred. Link the parcel reference, requested protection and observed outcome. Keep financial reconciliation and a condition complaint distinct even when both arise from the same shipment. One concerns which services were paid for, while the other concerns the condition in which the goods arrived.
corrections.translation: 受け取り後に問題を報告する場合、外箱と中の配置を写真に残します。目で分かる状態を記録し、衝撃を受けた区間まで写真だけで断定しないでください。荷物番号、依頼した保護、到着状態を関連付けます。払ったサービス料の照合と、到着状態についての申し立ては、同じ荷物でも扱う問題が異なります。

corrections.source: A soft parcel can change dimensions depending on how it rests. Measure the maximum outer span as it would travel, including a thick pocket of material or protective padding. If it is later enclosed in a rigid carton, use the carton dimensions instead. Avoid pressing a soft measurement flat to obtain an attractive number unless the actual packing method keeps it that way. A parcel that expands after measuring no longer corresponds to the estimate.
corrections.translation: 柔らかい荷物は置き方で大きさが変わります。輸送時と同じ状態で、厚く重なった布や保護材を含め、最も外側の間隔を測ります。後から硬い外箱に入れるならそちらの外寸を使います。実際に平らな状態が維持されない限り、手で押さえて小さく測ってはいけません。手を離して膨らめば見積もりの前提が崩れます。

corrections.source: For an irregular object, record the length, width and height of its enclosing package rather than tracing curves around the object. A tape following the arc of a handle produces a distance along a curve. It does not show how wide the finished parcel is. Where the longest projection is hard to identify, request a wide view of the completed package and the measured spans. Label any estimate based on an unpacked object as provisional until the outer dimensions are known.
corrections.translation: 不規則な形の物は、輪郭をなぞらず、それを収めた外装の縦・横・高さを記録します。持ち手の曲線に沿って測っても、荷物の幅にはなりません。突出部がどこか分かりにくければ、梱包全体と測定の両端が見える写真を頼みます。梱包前の寸法に基づく見積もりには、外寸判明まで暫定と表示しておきます。

corrections.source: Several items can arrive with individually recorded weights. Adding those figures provides a starting estimate for contents, but the sum omits the final outer packaging and may include packaging that will later be removed. If there are two outbound boxes, do not enter their total weight alongside the dimensions of only the smaller one. Run the estimator once for each box, with that box's own dimensions, then combine the actual quote totals for your comparison.
corrections.translation: 入庫時の個別重量を合計しても、最終外箱は入らず、後で取り外す包装は含まれているかもしれません。荷物を2箱に分ける場合は、合計重量と小さい一方の外寸を組み合わせないでください。各箱の寸法と重量で個別に見積もりを取り、その2件の金額を足して比較します。

corrections.source: A good final check takes less time than investigating a mistaken quote. Read the three dimensions and their unit aloud, read the weight and its unit, confirm the destination, then confirm that every measurement describes the same physical box. Only at that point is the estimator result useful for comparing an offered service. If one measurement is still missing, state that explicitly when you share the result and keep the next decision conditional on obtaining it.
corrections.translation: 見積もりの誤りを後から調べるより、入力前の最終確認のほうが短時間で済みます。3辺と単位、重量と単位、配送先、すべて同じ箱のデータであることを順に確認します。値が1つでも欠けていれば共有時に明記し、それによって変わる判断は実測後まで保留します。

corrections.source: Now add a condition: the quoted combined arrangement relies on removing the retail case, which the buyer needs as part of a gift. The 185 quote no longer describes an acceptable solution. Obtain a comparable combined quote that keeps the case, or mark that arrangement as unsuitable. The earlier numerical comparison still teaches something about what created the saving, but it cannot justify selecting a packing method that defeats the purpose of the purchase.
corrections.translation: ただし、同梱185の条件が、贈り物に不可欠な商品のケースを外すことだったらどうでしょう。この案は条件を満たしません。ケースを残した同梱見積もりを取り直すか、不採用と記録します。当初の比較は何を外すと安くなるかを示せますが、購入の目的を損なう方法を選ぶ根拠にはなりません。

corrections.source: Take another fictional quote with a combined option at 214. The smaller boxes cost 112 and 94, for a total of 206, and their protective needs are already included. This time the arithmetic favours splitting by eight. Before deciding, verify whether there are additional services charged separately per parcel or any destination-specific conditions that were absent from the recorded totals. Two boxes can produce two delivery events and two references to monitor.
corrections.translation: 別の架空例では、同梱214に対し、小箱2個の見積もりが112と94で計206、必要な保護は込みです。計算上は別送が8安いですが、別料金の箱ごとのサービスや、特定の配送先でのみ必要な費用が抜けていないかを確認します。2箱なら配達が2回になり、追跡番号も2件管理することになります。

corrections.source: A rectangular case can set the minimum width of a combined parcel. Soft clothing may fill empty space around it, or may require an increase in height once protection is included. Do not calculate a combined box by adding the item lengths, adding widths and adding heights independently. That describes a much larger imagined arrangement in most cases. Sketch how the pieces could sit and ask for relevant packed measurements or a realistic packing estimate.
corrections.translation: 硬いケースが入ると、それが同梱箱の最小幅を決めることがあります。柔らかい衣類は周りの隙間に入る場合も、保護材を入れると高さが増す場合もあります。商品の縦どうし、横どうし、高さどうしを別々に足すと、実際よりずっと大きい箱を想定しがちです。配置を描き、実測値や現実的な梱包後寸法を尋ねてください。

corrections.source: Put the route's displayed freight figure on one line. Beneath it, list each other cost you expect to encounter: seller price, domestic delivery, packing services and any other item actually named on the offer. Mark each one as included, separately quoted, already paid or unknown. Treat an omitted entry as unknown unless the live terms tell you otherwise. An estimate showing only international delivery cannot settle the price of seller-side goods.
corrections.translation: まず表示運賃を1行に置き、ほかに見込む商品代、国内送料、梱包サービス、その見積もりに明記された料金を並べます。「込み」「別途見積もり」「支払済み」「不明」を個々に付けます。現在の条件に説明がないものを自動的に無料とはしません。国際運賃の表示だけでは、店側の商品代までは確定しません。

corrections.source: The destination is part of the quote. Use the correct country and any region or postal information the estimator requests on the official page. If you share a comparison with someone, retain enough information to identify the route while removing the full delivery address. A screenshot of two prices cannot establish identical coverage when the destination fields are out of view.
corrections.translation: 配送先は見積もり条件の一部です。公式ページで国と、求められる地域・郵便番号を正確に入力します。比較を共有するときは配送範囲が分かる情報は残し、番地などの詳細は伏せます。配送先が切れたスクリーンショットで2つの金額だけを見ても、対象地域が等しいことまでは確かめられません。

corrections.source: When an item changes after quotation
corrections.translation: 見積もり後に中身や仕様が変わった場合

corrections.source: Changing the contents, packing, measurements or selected services calls for a fresh estimate. Keep the old result because it can help explain a later difference. Mark the revised input with the reason for the change, such as a retained shoebox or a removed accessory. Ask HubBuy support about a specific line if the conditions appear identical but the quoted result still differs.
corrections.translation: 中身、梱包、寸法、サービスが変わったら再見積もりします。初回の結果も残し、「靴箱を保持」「付属品を除外」などの理由を新しい条件に添えます。条件が同じように見えても結果が違うなら、対象の明細行を特定してHubBuyの窓口に問い合わせてください。

corrections.source: Turn one unknown into one support question. Instead of asking whether the whole estimate is correct, specify that you entered a named destination and measured parcel, received a quote for a particular route, and need to know whether the selected packing service is already inside the displayed total. Save the answer with the date and the quote version. Avoid applying a reply about one route to a different service with different terms.
corrections.translation: 条件を示して質問を1つに絞ります。例えば「この配送先と実測荷物でこの経路の見積もりが出ました。選択した保護包装は表示総額に入っていますか」と聞けます。返答を日付と見積版と一緒に保存し、異なる条件の別サービスにはそのまま適用しないでください。

corrections.source: A useful quote summary fits into a short paragraph: name the destination, contents, dimensions, scale weight, route, currency and the date of the estimate. Add a sentence identifying any fee that is known to be separate and any part still unresolved. Keep private delivery and payment details out of shared screenshots. Another buyer can then reproduce the estimate for the same inputs or identify why their own parcel differs.
corrections.translation: 配送先、内容、寸法、はかりの重量、経路、通貨、見積日を短い段落にまとめます。別料金と判明した項目や、未解決の条件も1文足します。共有画像から住所や支払いの個人情報を除くと、相手は必要な情報だけで同条件の試算や自分の荷物との違いの確認ができます。

corrections.source: When the final route appears identical by name, check any displayed service variation or delivery zone. Two similar names may describe different delivery products. Compare actual route identifiers if the account exposes them. Save relevant screenshots with private addresses and payment information cropped out before sharing. If a code has changed but its meaning is unclear, ask support to confirm whether the quote and statement refer to the same service.
corrections.translation: 名称が同じように見えても、配送区域や細かいサービス区分を確認します。識別コードが見える場合は両方を照合してください。共有する画像では住所と支払情報を伏せます。コードだけが変わり意味が判別できなければ、見積もりと明細が同じサービスか窓口に確認します。

corrections.source: Reconcile several outbound packages against one original quote
corrections.translation: 1件の見積もりを複数の最終発送と照合する

corrections.source: Sources
corrections.translation: 参考資料

corrections.source: HubBuy shopping guides
corrections.translation: HubBuy購入ガイド

corrections.source: Work through the figures behind a HubBuy purchase, from domestic delivery charges to a final parcel statement.
corrections.translation: 中国国内の送料から国際小包の最終請求まで、HubBuyでの購入にかかる費用を明細ごとに確認します。

corrections.source: HubBuy spreadsheet FAQ
corrections.translation: HubBuy商品一覧についてよくある質問

corrections.source: A delivery line can disappear from your budget or appear twice, depending on where you write it. Follow one seller order to the warehouse before assigning any part of that charge to an international parcel.
corrections.translation: 送料をどこに記録するかによって、1区間分が抜けたり、同じ料金を二重に数えたりします。国際小包に費用を配分する前に、まず出品者1人の注文を、店から倉庫に届くまで追ってみましょう。

corrections.source: Follow the physical delivery
corrections.translation: 荷物の移動を区間ごとに追う

corrections.source: HubBuy's public purchase guide describes paying for the product and shipping within China at the ordering stage. International shipping appears later, after warehousing and the selection of items to send abroad. Draw the journey on a scrap of paper. Put the shop on the left, the receiving warehouse in the middle and your address on the right. Mark which leg the delivery charge on your screen actually covers. A seller's promise of free delivery may answer the first question while leaving the last leg entirely open.
corrections.translation: HubBuyの購入ガイドでは、注文時に商品代と中国国内の送料を払い、倉庫に届いて海外へ送る品物を選んだ後に国際送料を確認します。紙に「店→倉庫→自宅」と書き、画面の送料がどの区間にかかるか印を付けてください。店の「送料無料」は倉庫までの料金を示すことがあり、自宅までの国際送料までは分かりません。

corrections.source: Read one order before dividing the charge
corrections.translation: 送料を分ける前に注文全体を見る

corrections.source: Suppose one shop supplies two T-shirts at 68 yuan each and a cap at 42 yuan. The checkout shows a single domestic charge of 10 yuan. The seller order totals 188 yuan. Three separate rows in your shortlist should not turn that into three charges of 10. Keep the 10 on a summary line until you have a reason to calculate the cost of an individual piece. Record who collected the payment and which seller order number appears beside it.
corrections.translation: 同じ店で1枚68元のTシャツ2枚と42元の帽子を買い、注文全体の国内送料が10元なら、合計は188元です。表に商品が3行あるからといって、10元を3回加えてはいけません。送料はまとめて1行に記録し、1点当たりの原価が必要なときに配分します。代金の受取人と、支払いに表示された店の注文番号も控えます。

corrections.source: Choose an allocation method suited to your question
corrections.translation: 用途に応じた配分方法を選ぶ

corrections.source: If two people share the order, agreeing on a split matters more than producing a falsely precise cost per item. A simple split across three units gives approximately 3.33 yuan per piece with a one-cent rounding adjustment. Another method assigns the 10 in proportion to product value. Each 68-yuan shirt gets about 3.82 and the cap about 2.36. Both methods reproduce 188. Neither method can establish the seller's actual transport cost for the cap.
corrections.translation: 2人で注文するときは、まず送料をどう負担するか合意します。10元を商品3点で均等に割れば1点約3.33元で、0.01元の端数を調整します。商品代に比例させるなら、68元のTシャツにはそれぞれ約3.82元、帽子には約2.36元です。どちらでも注文総額は188元です。配分額から、帽子だけの輸送に店が実際にいくらかけたかは分かりません。

corrections.source: When one seller sends two boxes
corrections.translation: 同じ出品者が2箱に分けて送った場合

corrections.source: A second domestic tracking number can appear if the shop sends items separately. Look for a new payment line before adding a second shipping cost. One seller order can have two deliveries, just as one delivery can contain multiple garments. Track the boxes separately for receipt but keep the financial record tied to what was actually charged. If an item has not arrived, a delivery scan for the first box tells you very little about the location of the second.
corrections.translation: 店が分けて発送すると、国内の追跡番号が2件になることがあります。送料を増やす前に、新しい請求が本当にあるかを調べてください。1件の注文が2回に分かれることも、1箱に何枚も服が入ることもあります。入庫状況は箱別、支出は請求別に記録します。1箱目の配達完了だけでは、2箱目の場所や到着は分かりません。

corrections.source: What changes after a cancellation
corrections.translation: キャンセル後に変わる項目

corrections.source: If the cap is cancelled, avoid immediately subtracting 42 from the old total and treating the result as settled. Check the refund statement for the product amount and any domestic adjustment. The original allocation may now describe goods that never travelled together. Keep the original order and add a dated credit row, then calculate the remaining cost from the surviving items. Ask for clarification with the purchase reference if the domestic charge has no corresponding adjustment explanation.
corrections.translation: 帽子をキャンセルしても、元の合計から42を引いただけで精算済みとしないでください。商品代の返金と国内送料の調整を明細で別々に確認します。元の配分はすべての品物が一緒に動く前提だったかもしれません。注文記録を残し、日付入りの返金行を追加して、残る品物の原価を算出します。送料の扱いが不明なら購入番号を添えて尋ねましょう。

corrections.source: A worked comparison with two sellers
corrections.translation: 2店舗で同じ商品を買う場合の計算例

corrections.source: Consider a buyer choosing between two offers for the same packs of plain socks. Shop Green lists the selected packs at 24 yuan each and shows 8 yuan domestic delivery for the order. Shop Blue lists them at 26 each with domestic delivery included in the displayed checkout. At a quantity of one, Green costs 32 and Blue costs 26. At a quantity of three, the totals are 80 and 78. At a quantity of four, both cost 104. These break-even figures assume the prices and delivery conditions remain fixed as quantity changes. Open each checkout again at the intended quantity before basing a purchase on the calculation.
corrections.translation: 靴下1パックがGreenでは24元、国内送料は注文全体で8元とします。Blueでは1パック26元で国内送料込みです。1パックなら両店の支払額は32元と26元、3パックなら80元と78元、4パックならどちらも104元です。数量で単価や送料条件が変わらなければ、4パックで並びます。購入する数量を各店の決済画面で指定し、実際の総額を確認してください。

corrections.source: Splitting the cost of a group order
corrections.translation: 共同購入の送料を分ける

corrections.source: Two friends agree to buy from one shop. Mei chooses one garment costing 120 yuan and Arun chooses four accessories at 20 yuan each. The single domestic charge is 12. Dividing by five units gives Mei 2.40 and Arun 9.60 of the delivery cost. Dividing in proportion to merchandise value gives Mei 7.20 and Arun 4.80. Splitting the delivery equally makes each share six. All three methods reconcile to the same total. The important question is which agreement the people sharing the bill intend, not which method produces the lowest price for a particular person's line.
corrections.translation: メイは120元の服1着、アルンは20元のアクセサリー4個を同じ店から買い、国内送料は合計12元でした。5点で割るとメイは2.40元、アルンは9.60元です。商品代に比例させると7.20元と4.80元、2人で折半すれば各6元です。合計はいずれも12元です。誰か1人にとって最安の方法ではなく、合意したルールを使います。

corrections.source: Put that agreement in the note accompanying the order before asking either friend to settle. Record the original 12 as the amount on the seller order. Then display the chosen allocation in a separate column. If you later need to ask HubBuy about the domestic charge, send the seller-order figure. Sending one friend's allocated share as if it were the amount charged would create a discrepancy that exists only in your own accounting.
corrections.translation: 精算を頼む前に、注文メモに分け方を書いてください。店が請求した12は注文の送料欄に残し、個人別の負担額は別の列に記載します。後日HubBuyに国内送料を確認するときは、個人の分担額ではなく店の請求額を伝えます。分担額を請求額と取り違えると、自分の表の中だけで差額が発生します。

corrections.source: Separating a seller's refund from a delivery refund
corrections.translation: 商品代の返金と送料の返金を区別する

corrections.source: Consider a seller that receives payment for two 65-yuan pieces and one 12-yuan domestic charge. One piece cannot be supplied. The transaction history then shows a confirmed refund of 65. The net payment is 77. That total is consistent with one remaining piece and the original delivery charge, but it does not tell you whether a revised shipping arrangement was discussed. Check the refund description and the terms for the seller order before attributing a reason to it.
corrections.translation: 1点65元の商品を2点購入し、中国国内送料12元も支払いました。1点が欠品し、取引履歴で65元の返金が確認できたとします。差し引きの支出は77元で、残った1点と当初の送料に一致します。ただし、この数字だけで送料について再交渉したかは分かりません。返金理由の欄と注文条件を確認してください。

corrections.source: Reading common pieces of evidence
corrections.translation: 資料ごとに確認できること

corrections.source: A listing screenshot is useful for identifying the offer and the date. It may show a shipping statement for a default address, a default option or a promotional threshold that your order does not meet. A checkout screenshot with the exact options and receiving destination provides a better estimate. A payment confirmation tied to the seller order establishes what was actually collected. A refund record establishes a later movement. Preserve this sequence rather than replacing every earlier document with the latest one.
corrections.translation: 商品ページの画像は当時の掲載内容と日付を確かめるのに役立ちますが、既定の住所、初期の仕様、条件を満たしていないキャンペーン向けの送料かもしれません。選んだ仕様と実際の受け取り先が映る決済画面のほうが購入前の見積もりに適しています。実際の請求は注文番号に紐づく支払確認、その後の変動は返金明細で確かめます。古い資料を消さず時系列で保存してください。

corrections.source: Warehousing evidence answers a different question. A courier label can identify which package travelled. A warehouse entry can identify the items recorded as received. Neither document independently tells you how the seller calculated the price. If you need to connect a missing piece to a cost question, include the order summary and the delivery references together. For example, state that order X showed one domestic charge and two packages were received, and ask whether a second charge shown elsewhere belongs to this seller. Give support an identifiable line to investigate.
corrections.translation: 国内配送のラベルはどの箱が移動したか、入庫記録は何を受け取ったかを示しますが、どちらも店の値付けの根拠ではありません。欠品と送料を一緒に調べるなら注文概要と両方の配送番号を示し、「注文Xの国内送料は1回、届いた箱は2個です。この別の請求も同じ店のものですか」と尋ねると、調査対象を特定できます。

corrections.source: A quick check before accepting the total
corrections.translation: 合計を確定する前の確認

corrections.source: Read your worksheet from left to right. Can you point to the selected selling unit, the number purchased, the seller-level subtotal, the domestic charge collected, any later credit and the resulting net? Mark any estimate that still rests on an unconfirmed delivery price. If the merchandise is already paid for and a friend only needs an approximate per-item share, explain the allocation method and its rounding. If you are comparing two live sellers, use their full domestic totals at the same quantity. Save international shipping for the parcel comparison, where its own inputs can be checked.
corrections.translation: 販売単位、数量、店ごとの小計、国内送料、返金、差引額を表の左から順に追ってください。未確定の送料による見積もりには印を付けます。支払済みの商品を友人と精算するだけなら配分方法と端数処理を示しましょう。現時点の2店舗を比べるなら同じ数量と国内送料込み総額で比較します。国際送料は梱包条件が分かってから別途比べます。

corrections.source: Before comparing the size of two charges, identify what each service does, which object it applies to and whether it has already entered the amount due.
corrections.translation: 料金の大小を比べる前に、どの作業を、何に対して行い、その料金がすでに支払総額に入っているかを確認します。

corrections.source: Give each charge a unit
corrections.translation: 請求単位を記入する

corrections.source: HubBuy links separately to Service & Fees and Logistics Shipping Fees. Open the current description that matches the stage you are reviewing. Copy the name as it appears on your statement. Write a unit beside it: one purchased unit, one order, one packed box or one international parcel. A figure of six beside a packing option means something different if it is applied once per parcel than if it is applied to each item.
corrections.translation: HubBuyではサービス料金と物流・送料の説明を別々に案内しています。対象の段階に合う説明を開き、明細の項目名をそのまま控えます。横に「商品1点」「注文1件」「梱包箱1個」「国際小包1個」のように単位を書きます。梱包欄の「6」も、荷物ごとか商品ごとかで総額が変わります。

corrections.source: Consider a hypothetical worksheet with three product entries, two inner cartons and one outer parcel. Assume the quoted service is 4 yuan per inner carton and an outer-packing option costs 7 yuan for the parcel. The worksheet should add 8 and 7, or 15 in total. Multiplying both charges by three because there are three item rows produces 33. This example illustrates the arithmetic only; read the actual service units and amounts on the live offer.
corrections.translation: 商品3点を内箱2個に入れ、外箱1個で送るとします。内箱のサービスが1箱4元、外箱の梱包が1個の小包につき7元なら、8 + 7 = 15元です。商品が3行あるからと両方の料金を3倍にすると、誤って33元になります。これは計算例です。実際の単位と金額は現在の見積もりで確認してください。

corrections.source: Separate optional and included services
corrections.translation: 任意の追加と料金込みの作業を分ける

corrections.source: Keep evidence of the requested work
corrections.translation: 依頼した作業を記録に残す

corrections.source: A service name alone may be ambiguous after dispatch. If you need a bag protected from crushing, write down whether you asked for an inner box, corner protection or to keep the original packaging. Retain the confirmation attached to the parcel. If the result differs, show what was requested and which visible feature is missing. Support can investigate a specific operation more readily than a general complaint about expensive packing.
corrections.translation: 発送後にサービス名だけを見ても、作業内容が分からないことがあります。かばんのつぶれ防止なら、内箱、角の保護、元箱の保持のどれを頼んだか記録し、荷物に紐づく確認通知も保存します。到着状態が違えば、依頼と実際に見当たらない部分を示してください。「梱包が高かった」だけより、具体的な作業のほうが窓口も調べやすくなります。

corrections.source: Reconstructing a service total from a receipt
corrections.translation: 領収書からサービス料を確かめる

corrections.source: Here is a fictional receipt to practise with. Two fragile pieces require individual protective wrapping at 3 yuan per piece. One outer box uses a 9-yuan reinforcement option. The quoted base freight is 118. A screen then shows a parcel total of 133. The numbers reconcile because 118 plus six plus nine is 133. The words per piece and per parcel make the arithmetic reproducible. Without them, two buyers could look at the same three numbers and arrive at different totals.
corrections.translation: 架空の例では、壊れ物2点の個別包装が各3元、外箱1個の補強が9元、基本運賃が118元です。荷物の合計は118 + 6 + 9 = 133元となり、画面の133元と一致します。「1点ごと」と「1箱ごと」を区別しないと、同じ単価を見ている人どうしでも違う答えになってしまいます。

corrections.source: Suppose the final invoice shows 124 as freight including the two protective wraps and 9 on a separate line. The total is still 133. It would be misleading to report a new six-yuan increase merely because the value called freight rose from 118 to 124. Compare the composition of each displayed figure before comparing its magnitude. If the final description does not make clear whether the wraps are inside the 124, ask for the breakdown. Record an unresolved question instead of changing a line description to make the numbers fit.
corrections.translation: 最終明細では個別包装2点分が運賃に入り、運賃124と別料金9と表示されたとします。合計は変わらず133です。運賃欄が118から124になっただけで6の追加負担が発生したとはいえません。内訳を合わせてから金額を比較します。124に個別包装が入っているか書かれていなければ、推測で項目名を変えず、内訳を問い合わせてください。

corrections.source: What to do when the same service appears twice
corrections.translation: 同じ名前のサービスが2回出てきたら

corrections.source: A familiar label can denote two legitimate operations. An item-level service can prepare one fragile object before it enters a parcel, while a parcel-level service can reinforce the outer box. Open the details of each entry and compare the object being handled, the quantity and the stated purpose. If one charge is attached to a purchase reference and another to an outbound parcel, save both references. A shared word such as protection does not establish a duplicate.
corrections.translation: 似た名前でも別の作業があり得ます。例えば、商品を箱に入れる前の個別包装と、外箱自体の補強です。各明細を開き、対象、数量、目的を調べます。一方に購入番号、もう一方に国際小包番号が紐づいていれば両方控えます。「保護」という共通の言葉だけでは二重請求とは判断できません。

corrections.source: Ask for an outcome you can identify
corrections.translation: 写真や到着時に確認できる形で依頼する

corrections.source: Distinguish a cost comparison from a quality judgment
corrections.translation: 価格と保護内容を別々に判断する

corrections.source: A lower service price is useful only if it addresses the actual concern. Someone sending replacement parts may care that small components stay bundled. Someone sending a gift might care that the retail carton remains intact. These people can receive identical freight quotes yet make different rational decisions about optional work. Write a one-sentence acceptance condition for each service you consider. For a loose accessory, it could be that it remains with its known parent item inside the package.
corrections.translation: 低い料金に意味があるのは、必要な条件を満たす場合です。交換部品なら小さな部品の散逸を防ぐこと、贈り物なら化粧箱を傷めないことが目的かもしれません。同一運賃でも必要な追加作業は違います。「緩い付属品は該当する本体と一緒に袋に入っている」など、受け入れられる状態をサービスごとに1文で書いてください。

corrections.source: After delivery, compare that condition with what you can observe. A well-protected outer corner is not evidence that an internal accessory was separately wrapped. If an instruction appears to have been missed, show the order acknowledgement, the selected service and a picture of the relevant part of the received package. Avoid attributing damage to a particular event without evidence. State the requested outcome and what you found, then ask which next step applies.
corrections.translation: 到着したら、その条件と目で確認できる状態を照合します。外箱の角が保護されていても、中の付属品を個別包装した証拠にはなりません。指示どおりでないときは、注文の受付、選んだサービス、届いた箱の該当箇所の写真を示してください。依頼内容と実際の状態を伝え、証拠がないまま特定の輸送段階を原因と決めつけず、次の手続きを尋ねます。

corrections.source: A support message that isolates an unexplained amount
corrections.translation: 説明できない差額だけを尋ねる

corrections.source: When a reply comes back, enter the provider's explanation beside the line it concerns. If the difference is a previously unseen quantity, correct the quantity column. If it is an already established charge, link it to the earlier entry rather than creating another. Once the detailed services, freight and credits reproduce the statement, your worksheet can serve two purposes: checking the present transaction and building a more realistic estimate for a future parcel with similar requirements.
corrections.translation: 返答を受けたら説明を該当行に書き込みます。数量が見落とされていれば数量欄を直し、すでに記録した費用ならその行に関連付けます。重複して項目を増やさないでください。サービス、運賃、返金の合計で請求書を再現できれば、今回の支払いを確認するとともに、次に同様の条件で送る際の予算資料にもなります。

corrections.source: Multiple choices on one marketplace listing can mean different units, quantities and prices. Build the estimate from confirmed options before applying delivery or discounts.
corrections.translation: 同じ商品ページでも、選択肢によって販売単位、入数、価格が変わります。確定した仕様の小計を出してから、送料や割引を計算します。

corrections.source: Make the seller's selling unit explicit
corrections.translation: 店が何を1単位として売っているか確認する

corrections.source: Read each option before copying the lowest displayed price. A listing can offer a complete set, a single piece, a replacement part or more than one pack size. Save the seller's option text in its original language as well as your translation. If you are buying two shirts in one colour and another in a different size, give them separate lines. An entry saying only three shirts gives you no way to check which line changed when the seller confirms part of the order.
corrections.translation: 最安の表示価格を書き写す前に各選択肢を読んでください。セット、単品、交換部品、異なる入数のパックが同じページに並ぶ場合があります。仕様名は翻訳と原文の両方を保存します。同じ色のシャツ2枚とサイズ違い1枚なら別の行に書きます。「シャツ3枚」だけでは一部欠品の連絡が来ても、どれが変更されたか追えません。

corrections.source: Build the merchandise subtotal first
corrections.translation: 商品小計を先に出す

corrections.source: For example, assume the selected medium shirt costs 72 yuan, the large costs 76 and the two-piece set costs 130. Selecting two medium shirts and one set costs 274 before delivery. Accidentally using the 72-yuan shirt price for the set gives 216. The 58-yuan difference comes from selecting the wrong unit, not from a hidden freight charge. Keeping pack type, option, unit price and quantity in separate columns makes the error visible.
corrections.translation: Mサイズのシャツが72元、Lサイズが76元、上下セットが130元なら、Mサイズ2枚とセット1組は送料前で274元です。セットにも72元を当てはめると216元になり、58元ずれます。これは隠れた運賃ではなく、販売単位の取り違えです。セット種別、仕様、単価、数量を別々の列にすると見つけやすくなります。

corrections.source: Check minimums and tiers against the selected mix
corrections.translation: 最低購入数と段階価格を選んだ組み合わせに当てはめる

corrections.source: Split a discount using the rule printed on the order
corrections.translation: 注文に記載された条件で割引を配分する

corrections.source: Look at the seller summary before allocating the saving. A promotion may apply only to certain items or may change when a unit is cancelled. Keep the eligibility conditions with the order. When you simply need to share a bill, state your allocation method separately from the seller's calculation. For example, proportional distribution among eligible items may be fair among friends but does not describe which refund the seller will approve later.
corrections.translation: 割引を分ける前に店の注文概要を確認してください。一部の商品のみ対象だったり、1点を取り消すと割引が消えたりします。適用条件も保存します。友人どうしの精算で対象商品の金額に応じて配分することと、店が後日いくら返金するかは別です。自分たちの配分方法を店の計算と分けて記録します。

corrections.source: Carry item identities into the warehouse
corrections.translation: 倉庫でも注文の各行と実物を対応させる

corrections.source: Give each line a stable name, such as navy shirt medium or blue set large. When two deliveries appear, match warehouse entries to those names and counts. Keep one cancelled line in the ledger as cancelled rather than reusing its identifier for another piece. Before submitting a parcel, compare the count of completed entries against what you paid for. A total that balances financially can still conceal a missing colour or an incomplete set.
corrections.translation: 「紺シャツ・M」「青のセット・L」など、行ごとに識別できる名前を付けます。荷物が2つ届いたら、各入庫記録の品名と数を照合してください。キャンセル行はそう表示して残し、別商品の番号として再利用しません。国際発送の前に入庫が完了した数と支払済みの数を比較しましょう。金額が合っていても特定の色やセットの一部が不足している場合があります。

corrections.source: Buying for three people from one option grid
corrections.translation: 3人が同じ一覧から違う仕様を選ぶとき

corrections.source: Imagine three friends choosing trousers from one listing. One selects the unlined version in size medium, another selects the lined version in medium and the third selects the unlined version in large. The listing title and seller number are identical on all three records. The information that distinguishes them lives in the option columns. Write one complete selection per line and name the recipient in your private sheet. If the seller option names are translated alike, keep the original wording and thumbnail beside the selections.
corrections.translation: 3人で同じ商品ページのパンツを買うとします。1人は裏地なしM、1人は裏地ありM、もう1人は裏地なしLです。商品タイトルと店の商品番号は全員同じで、違うのは仕様です。1行に1人分の選択をすべて書き、自分用の表に受取人も記入します。翻訳すると同じ名前になる仕様には原文と選択画像を付けてください。

corrections.source: Checking a multi-pack against single units
corrections.translation: 複数入りパックと単品を比べる

corrections.source: Read the size and colour assortment on the pack. A five-pack may contain an assortment chosen by the seller rather than five duplicates of a selected colour. If only two pairs match the need, dividing by five is a misleading measure of value to that buyer. Before paying, write a sentence describing exactly what should arrive: five wearable pairs in size X, with the colours distributed as stated in option Y. This sentence becomes a usable warehouse count instead of a number with no physical meaning.
corrections.translation: パックのサイズと色構成も確認します。5足パックは、選んだ色5足ではなく店指定のアソートかもしれません。必要な色が2足だけなら、価格を5で割っても自分にとっての価値を表しません。「サイズXで履ける5足、色の内訳は選択肢Yの記載どおり」といった形で受け取り条件を書いておきます。倉庫でも中身に即して数えられます。

corrections.source: Handling a partial stock confirmation
corrections.translation: 一部だけ在庫が確定した場合

corrections.source: Take the example of two medium shirts and a set. If the seller confirms only one medium shirt, the original 274 no longer describes the goods available. One shirt at 72 plus the set at 130 gives a merchandise total of 202. Check whether a quantity threshold, domestic delivery condition or discount has changed as well. A cancellation can affect more than the removed unit if the promotion depended on the original basket.
corrections.translation: Mサイズのシャツ2枚とセット1組の例で、店がMを1枚しか用意できないとします。元の274はもう実際に買える商品の小計ではありません。シャツ72とセット130を合わせて202です。数量条件、国内送料、割引適用も再確認してください。元のカート全体に対する特典なら、取り消した商品の金額以外にも影響します。

corrections.source: Identifying a quantity mistake before it travels
corrections.translation: 発送前に数量違いを見分ける

corrections.source: A photograph of three unopened packets can confirm that three packets are present. It may not confirm the number of units inside each. For a set with different contents per package, ask for a view or label that distinguishes the package versions without damaging packaging the seller may require. For separate garment sizes, match each readable size tag to a line on the paid order, especially when two colours differ only slightly under warehouse lighting.
corrections.translation: 未開封の袋が3つ並んだ写真で、袋が3つあることは分かりますが、各袋の入数までは断定できません。中身の異なるセットがあるなら、返品条件に関わる包装を破らずに判別できるラベルや外観の写真を頼みます。衣類のサイズ違いなら、読めるサイズタグを支払済み注文の行に結び付けます。倉庫の照明で似た色に見えるときは特に有効です。

corrections.source: If you receive one packet with a handwritten count of four, compare that with the seller's stated packing unit before reporting a shortage. Four accessories inside one bag may fulfill four units, whereas four empty protective sleeves do not. Describe the observable fact in your message and ask a concrete question. For instance, the order includes three two-piece sets and the warehouse entry shows three sealed packages; could you verify whether each package contains both listed pieces?
corrections.translation: 袋に手書きで「4」とあっても、まず店の販売単位を確認します。1袋に付属品が4点入っていれば4単位を満たすかもしれませんが、空の保護スリーブ4本は商品4点ではありません。「2点入りを3セット注文し、入庫写真では未開封の袋が3つです。各袋に記載の2点が入っているか確認できますか」と、見えた事実に基づいて依頼します。

corrections.source: Keeping product mathematics separate from outbound freight
corrections.translation: 商品の原価計算と国際送料を分ける

corrections.source: The price per usable item can be useful before purchase, but do not silently add a future international fee to each seller line and treat the result as confirmed. Once the goods arrive, a shared parcel may contain items from several purchases and use packing that was unknown earlier. Retain the confirmed seller costs and add a separate outbound comparison when measured figures become available. If you later allocate freight among recipients, document that policy separately.
corrections.translation: 実際に使える1点当たりの費用は購入前の判断に役立ちます。一方、まだ確定していない国際送料を各店の行に足して確定額にはしません。入庫後は複数注文を同梱するかもしれず、梱包も未定です。店の確定原価を残し、実測値がそろってから別に国際送料を比較します。受取人どうしで分ける場合は分担ルールも別に記録してください。

corrections.source: A complete record lets you answer three questions without recalculating from memory. Which version and quantity did the seller agree to supply? How much was actually collected or returned on the purchase? Which items are ready for international submission? A purchase line can be financially complete while one piece is still waiting for identification, so close each line only when its contents and its payment history are both clear.
corrections.translation: 必要な情報がそろった記録なら、店が約束した仕様と個数、実際に支払った額と返った額、国際発送できる品物を記憶に頼らず確認できます。決済が終わっていても、1点の識別がまだということはあります。中身と資金の動きの両方が明らかになってから、その行を完了にします。

corrections.source: A multi-shop shortlist can look like one cart, while costs and delivery events still originate with different sellers. Organize the purchase by shop first and the international shipment by parcel later.
corrections.translation: 複数の店の商品が1つのカートに見えても、請求や入庫は出品者ごとに発生します。購入時は店別に、後の国際発送は荷物別に整理します。

corrections.source: Create a small register for each seller
corrections.translation: 店ごとに小さな購入台帳を作る

corrections.source: Save the original listing, chosen option, quantity, product amount and domestic delivery shown for that particular purchase. Put discounts under the shop where they apply. Two listings sharing the same studio photo can still be offered by different sellers. Use the shop identity and the marketplace listing number to distinguish them, and give the lines names you will recognize even if the seller edits the title.
corrections.translation: 元の掲載ページ、選択仕様、数量、商品代、その注文の国内送料を記録します。割引は実際に適用された店に付けます。同じスタジオ写真を使う別の店もあるため、店名と元サイトの商品番号を控え、後日タイトルが変わっても分かる品名を表に付けてください。

corrections.source: Keep committed costs separate from intentions
corrections.translation: 確定額と購入予定を区別する

corrections.source: Suppose shop A has confirmed a 90-yuan jacket and 8 yuan delivery. Shop B still shows a 54-yuan scarf with domestic delivery unknown. Shop C has cancelled a 30-yuan accessory and its refund has not arrived. Show 98 as the confirmed purchase cost for A, 54 plus an unresolved amount as the estimate for B and 30 as a pending credit if it was actually paid. Adding everything into one definite subtotal would hide three different states.
corrections.translation: 店Aは上着90元と送料8元を確定。店Bのマフラーは54元で国内送料が不明。店Cの30元の小物はキャンセル済みで返金待ちとします。Aは98元の確定支出、Bは54元に未確定送料を加えた見込み、Cは支払済みであれば30元の返金待ちです。ひとつの確定小計にすると、この3つの状態が見えなくなります。

corrections.source: Track arrivals without changing the accounting basis
corrections.translation: 入庫の進捗と費用を別々に記録する

corrections.source: The parcel that reaches the warehouse first may belong to the last shop you ordered from. An arrival changes what you can inspect or submit for shipping, but does not automatically create an additional seller charge. Record the domestic tracking reference against the purchase and the warehouse reference against the received unit. If two tracking numbers arrive for one seller order, confirm the contents of each before treating either shipment as complete.
corrections.translation: 最後に注文した店の荷物が先に倉庫に届く場合もあります。到着すると検品や発送依頼に進めますが、自動的に追加送料がかかるわけではありません。店への注文に国内追跡番号を付け、受け取った品物には入庫番号を付けます。ひとつの注文に2件の追跡番号があれば、中身を確認してから受け取り完了にしてください。

corrections.source: Decide what waiting for the last item costs
corrections.translation: 最後の商品を待つ条件を整理する

corrections.source: Write down the warehouse deadlines for the items already stored and the latest confirmed information for the missing piece. Compare a combined parcel when all items arrive with sending the ready items now. Do not assign an invented cost to waiting. If a storage charge or packing service could matter, check the current account information. If the item has a firm use date, represent that constraint separately from the freight comparison.
corrections.translation: 保管済みの商品には倉庫の期限を、未着品には最後に確認された状況を記録します。全品を待って同梱する案と、準備済みの品を先に送る案を比べ、待つこと自体に架空の費用は付けません。保管料や梱包料が関係しそうならアカウントで現在の条件を調べます。使用期限がある場合は運賃とは別の条件として明示してください。

corrections.source: Rebuild the final total from its records
corrections.translation: 明細から最終支出を再現する

corrections.source: Start with net merchandise across sellers. Add the domestic amounts actually charged once each, then add outbound parcel payments and any separately shown services. Subtract refunds only when you can match them to the correct purchase, currency and destination. A refund returned to an account balance may affect your usable balance differently from a credit to your original payment method. Keep both the economic cost and the payment history visible.
corrections.translation: 各店の正味の商品代を集計し、実際の国内送料、国際小包の支払い、別途請求のサービスを各1回加えます。返金は購入、通貨、返金先が一致してから差し引きます。アカウント残高への返金と元の支払方法への返金では、今すぐ使える額が違うことがあります。正味のコストと実際の入出金を両方見えるようにします。

corrections.source: A basket that changes while the first item is in storage
corrections.translation: 最初の商品が保管中にカートが変わる場合

corrections.source: Deciding who owes what in a shared basket
corrections.translation: 共同購入の精算方法

corrections.source: Suppose one friend buys from shop A only and another friend buys from shops B and C. Individual seller charges belong to the appropriate purchase first. The friends might then agree to divide the international shipping equally, by weight or according to another rule. Keep that private agreement separate from the charges the sellers or HubBuy applied. A buyer's contribution can change when the packing plan changes even if no seller has altered its own amount.
corrections.translation: 友人の1人がA店のみ、もう1人がB店とC店で買った場合、各店の料金はまず該当の注文に計上します。国際送料はその後で、人数割り、重量割りなど合意した方法で配分します。友人間の約束と、店やHubBuyが実際に請求した費用は別です。各店の価格が変わらなくても、梱包方法が変われば個人の負担が変わり得ます。

corrections.source: For example, three purchases might have net totals of 106, 64 and 180 yuan. Their combined purchase cost is 350. If one purchase later gets a 20-yuan credit, the new cost is 330. Assign that credit to the purchase it belongs to before splitting anything else. Subtracting it from the international parcel total would make it harder to explain either the net seller cost or the eventual outbound charge. Show a pending credit separately until it actually appears.
corrections.translation: 3件の正味購入額が106元、64元、180元なら合計350元です。そのうちの1件で20元の返金が確定すれば、合計は330元になります。返金を先にその購入行に対応させてから他の費用を配分します。国際送料から引いてしまうと、店での正味支出も国際配送の実費も分かりにくくなります。入金まで待っている返金は別欄に置いてください。

corrections.source: Inventory matching across deliveries
corrections.translation: 複数の配送から届いた品物を照合する

corrections.source: Use a unique row identifier for each chosen option. A short name such as coat-A-small is enough in a personal worksheet if it also points to the underlying order reference. When an intake notification arrives, match the item to a row using the seller, domestic tracking and identifying details. If two similar bags came from different shops, a studio picture shared by both shops is weaker evidence than the corresponding delivery record.
corrections.translation: 各行には固有の識別名を付けます。「A店コートS」などの短い名前で十分ですが、元の注文番号にも結び付けます。入庫通知が届いたら、店、国内追跡番号、品物の特徴で照合します。似たバッグが別の店から来た場合、店どうしで共通の宣材写真より、個々の配送記録のほうが出所を確かめる手掛かりになります。

corrections.source: If a delivery appears without an obvious match, do not immediately reassign it to whichever row is still blank. Check how many pieces each seller was expected to send, the last known tracking events and any note about a split delivery. Contact support with the specific unresolved record and the candidate orders. A clear inquiry might say that two domestic numbers were expected from shop C, one has an identifiable bag in stock, and you need help matching the second number to its intake.
corrections.translation: 入庫品がどの行に当たるかすぐ分からなくても、空いている行に当てはめないでください。店別の発送予定個数、最後の追跡情報、分割配送の連絡を確認します。そのうえで「C店から国内の番号が2件あり、片方のバッグは識別できました。もう一方の入庫記録を照合してください」と、未解決の番号と候補の注文を挙げて尋ねます。

corrections.source: Planning the outbound comparison with unresolved costs
corrections.translation: 費用が未確定のまま発送を比較する

corrections.source: Keep unknown amounts visibly unknown. A blank field frequently gets treated as zero when a spreadsheet sums a column. Add a status such as awaiting domestic quote to flag a missing charge. If the seller confirms a range instead of a final amount, preserve both endpoints for planning and mark the calculation as conditional. Use the exact amount on the confirmed payment record when it becomes available.
corrections.translation: 表計算の空欄は合計でゼロ扱いされることがあります。未確定の送料には「国内送料の返答待ち」などの状態を付けます。店が価格の範囲だけを示したら上限と下限を残し、条件付きの予算と明記します。確定した支払記録が出た段階で実額を使うようにします。

corrections.source: You can still make a useful decision with one missing number. Assume the confirmed items total 250 yuan and the preferred basket has a hard merchandise budget of 300. There is 50 left for the unresolved item plus any remaining seller charges. If the item's selected price alone exceeds 50, you already know this plan will exceed that budget, even before international freight. If the selected item costs 40, the decision turns on the remaining conditions. The calculation identifies what you need to ask next.
corrections.translation: 確定した商品代が250元、商品予算の上限が300元なら、残る商品と店側の追加料金に使えるのは合わせて50元です。その商品の選択価格だけで50元を超えれば、国際送料を入れなくても予算超過です。40元なら残る条件次第です。1件の値段が不明でも、何を確認すべきかは絞れます。

corrections.source: Closing the basket without losing its history
corrections.translation: 変更の履歴を残してカートを締める

corrections.source: After delivery, keep a final list of which purchases ended up in which parcel. Some may be returned, sent later or accepted as replacements. If you sent the coat earlier and the two bags later, the original one-box estimate is useful historical information, not the final transport bill. Enter two outbound references and their confirmed amounts. Where an amount is in another currency, retain its original value and the actual converted payment entry.
corrections.translation: 受け取り後、どの店の何をどの箱で送ったか最終一覧を残します。返品、後日発送、交換品も識別します。コートを先に、バッグ2個を後から送ったなら、最初の1箱の見積もりは経緯の資料であって最終運賃ではありません。2箱それぞれの国際小包番号と確定額、別通貨の支払いなら元の額と実際の換算後の記録も保存します。

corrections.source: Finish by checking arithmetic in stages. Sum retained merchandise by shop. Add domestic delivery shown on the relevant purchases. Apply confirmed seller credits. Add final parcel payments and separately billed services only once. Reconcile any friend-to-friend allocation to the result. The resulting total can then be traced to records the people involved can inspect, including the reason the final basket differs from the first shortlist.
corrections.translation: 最後に、手元に残した商品代を店別に合計し、該当注文の国内送料と確定した返金を反映します。国際小包の最終支払いと別サービスを各1回計上してから、個人の分担額の合計を照合します。各人が確認可能な記録を残せば、最終的なカートが当初の候補リストと違う理由も説明できます。

corrections.source: Two screenshots can show different numbers for the same purchase without showing a different underlying price. Work from a common currency, a stated conversion direction and an identical set of included charges.
corrections.translation: 同じ購入でも画面によって金額が違って見えることがあります。元の価格が変わったかを判断するには、通貨と換算方向をそろえ、両方が同じ費用を含むか確認します。

corrections.source: Decide what you are comparing
corrections.translation: どの数字を比べているか明らかにする

corrections.source: Make the exchange-rate direction readable
corrections.translation: 為替レートの向きを明記する

corrections.source: Normalize inclusions before the rate
corrections.translation: レートを比べる前にサービス内容をそろえる

corrections.source: Include payment fees exactly once
corrections.translation: 決済手数料を二重に計上しない

corrections.source: A card might show one all-in home-currency debit, or separate conversion and service entries. Record what the statement actually shows. If the statement amount is already converted and includes a fee, treating that total as a new source amount and applying another conversion repeats the adjustment. When comparing a live quote with a posted charge, document the quote time and posting date. A later rate can differ even when the merchandise price is identical.
