corrections.translation: カード明細には本国通貨の合計が1行で出ることも、換算や手数料が分かれて出ることもあります。実際の表示どおり記入します。手数料を含む換算済みの額を元の価格として再換算すると、調整を二重にすることになります。現在の見積もりと実際の引き落としを比べるときは取得時刻と記帳日も控えます。商品代が同じでもレートは変わり得ます。

corrections.source: Round at the point where payment rounds
corrections.translation: 実際の決済と同じ段階で端数を丸める

corrections.source: When a seller summary collects several lines into one payment, convert the original-currency subtotal for your comparison. Rounding every small item first can create a few cents of difference from converting the order once. For a reimbursement sheet you may still need per-person figures. State which line absorbs the rounding remainder so that the sum of the allocations matches the amount actually paid.
corrections.translation: 複数の商品行が1回の決済になる場合は、元の通貨で小計を出し、その小計を換算します。各点で先に端数を丸めてから足すと、注文全体を換算した場合と少し違うことがあります。共同購入の精算で個人別の金額が必要なら、誰の行で端数を調整したかを書き、合計が実際の支払額に一致するようにします。

corrections.source: Worked example with a fixed fee
corrections.translation: 定額手数料を含めた比較例

corrections.source: Keep a consistent direction in a mixed-currency worksheet
corrections.translation: 複数通貨の表で換算方向を統一する

corrections.source: If one seller quotes in yuan and another amount already appears in your home currency, define a single comparison column. Convert each source amount into that column once. A simple note next to the source amount should give its unit and the conversion direction. Enter 150 CNY and 7.50 CNY per home unit as separate fields. Check that the converted result times 7.50 returns the source amount before any fees.
corrections.translation: 店Aの価格は人民元、別の金額はすでに自分の通貨で表示されているなら、比較用の列を1つ作ります。元の金額をそれぞれ1回だけその列に換算します。「150 CNY」「自分の通貨1単位当たり7.50 CNY」のように金額とレートを別の欄に入力し、換算結果に7.50を掛けると手数料前の元の額に戻ることを確かめます。

corrections.source: A common mistake occurs when a friend pastes a displayed conversion into a column that ordinarily contains original yuan amounts. The sheet then converts an amount that has already been converted, creating an implausibly low total. Use clear column names and keep screenshots or payment references close to the corresponding row. If you cannot tell which currency a pasted number uses, leave it out of the combined total until you can identify its unit.
corrections.translation: 友人が換算済みの表示額を、本来は人民元の元値を入れる列に貼り付けると、表が2度目の換算を行って不自然に低い合計が出ます。列名に通貨を記し、画面画像や支払番号を対応する行に付けてください。貼り付けた数字の通貨が分からない場合は、確認できるまで合計から外します。

corrections.source: Compare estimates at the same point in the transaction
corrections.translation: 取引の同じ時点・同じ内容で比較する

corrections.source: A product card viewed in the morning and a payment statement issued days later are different observations. Changes in selected variant, quantity, discounts or payment method can alter the result before exchange rates are considered. Begin by reconstructing the original-currency merchandise subtotal. Add domestic shipping and any services the relevant screen includes. Only once both source subtotals describe the same purchase should you compare conversion rates.
corrections.translation: 朝の商品カードと数日後に発行された決済明細は、違う段階の数字です。仕様や数量、割引、決済方法の変更だけでも結果は変わります。まず元の通貨で商品小計を復元し、その画面が含む国内送料とサービスを加えます。同じ購入内容の小計にそろった段階で、初めて換算レートを比べてください。

corrections.source: What a refund can and cannot tell you
corrections.translation: 返金から分かることを見きわめる

corrections.source: A refund statement may show the original currency even when your card posts a home-currency credit. Record the two values in their own columns, matched by reference where possible. A different home-currency credit from the original debit can reflect several factors. Check the amount refunded in the original currency, the payment destination, any stated fee and the dates of the transactions before attributing a difference to exchange.
corrections.translation: 返金明細は元の通貨でも、カードには自分の通貨で返金されることがあります。取引番号があれば両方を対応付け、別の列に保存します。本国通貨の返金額が当初の引き落としと異なるときは、元通貨の返金額、返金先、記載手数料、両方の取引日を確認してください。為替だけが差の原因とは限りません。

corrections.source: Suppose a 150-yuan line was originally included within a larger payment. The later credit may refer to that one line only, not a proportion of every service on the initial order. Domestic delivery or optional work may have separate terms. Use the explicit refund breakdown or ask about the named purchase. Applying an old per-item estimate that included an allocated share of freight can create a supposed shortfall that the actual refund statement never promised to cover.
corrections.translation: 150元の商品行が大きな決済に含まれていた場合、返金がその商品1点だけを対象とし、元注文の全サービスは比例返金されないことがあります。国内送料や追加作業には別条件があり得ます。明示された返金内訳を調べるか、該当の購入番号で尋ねましょう。按分した送料を含む自分の単価を当てはめると、店が約束していない不足額を作ってしまいます。

corrections.source: Use a range when today's decision precedes payment
corrections.translation: 決済前の予算は幅を持たせる

corrections.source: When you receive the actual payment record, preserve your range and add the posted result beside it. State which differences came from the observed conversion and which came from changed contents or services. Share the source currency, the conversion used and the total amount due together whenever you discuss the quote with another person. This way the comparison can be reproduced without relying on a symbol such as a dollar sign that might refer to several different currencies.
corrections.translation: 実際の決済記録を入手しても、予算の範囲を残し横に実額を記入します。換算による差と、内容物や追加サービスの変更による差を分けます。見積もりを共有するときは、元通貨、換算方法、支払総額を一緒に示してください。複数の国で使うドル記号などに頼らず、相手が同じ計算を再現できます。

corrections.source: A practical final check
corrections.translation: 画面画像の金額を使う前の確認

corrections.source: Start with what needs protection
corrections.translation: 何をどの状態で届けたいか決める

corrections.source: Decide which part of the purchase must arrive in a particular condition. The concern might be a thin handle, vulnerable corners or a retail box needed as a gift. A request for the cheapest packing leaves the warehouse guessing about your priorities. Identify the item and the feature that matters. If keeping a retail box affects your decision, ask before authorizing its removal, particularly while any exchange question remains open.
corrections.translation: 細い持ち手、傷みやすい角、贈り物として残したい化粧箱など、守りたい部分を具体的にします。「一番安く梱包」とだけ頼むと、倉庫は優先順位を判断できません。該当品と大切な特徴を伝えてください。元箱の有無で購入判断が変わる場合、特に交換について確認中なら、処分を許可する前に相談します。

corrections.source: Define comparable packing options
corrections.translation: 比較できる梱包案を作る

corrections.source: In a teaching example, option A uses an existing carton and simple padding. Option B adds an inner protective shell. Write the cost of each quoted service, then measure or request the external weight and dimensions of the finished parcel under each arrangement. The shell may change the size available to a route, even if it adds little weight. Enter the same destination and product category for both estimates.
corrections.translation: 例として、Aは今の箱に簡単な緩衝材、Bはさらに内側の保護シェルを使うとします。作業ごとの見積額を控え、各案で梱包した場合の総重量と外寸を測るか、倉庫に尋ねます。軽いシェルでも大きさのために利用できる配送方法が変わる場合があります。両方に同じ配送先と商品カテゴリーを入力してください。

corrections.source: Separate the two price effects
corrections.translation: サービス料と運賃への影響を分ける

corrections.source: Look at packaging removal as a trade-off
corrections.translation: 梱包材を外す際の利点と条件を比べる

corrections.source: Removing an empty spacer can reduce volume without changing the protection needed. Removing a rigid box from an item that depends on it for shape is a different decision. Identify what will replace the original protection. Ask whether parts such as cards, straps, wrapping or detachable pieces will be retained. If your concern is size rather than weight, check the finished longest side instead of assuming that discarding a box always changes the available routes.
corrections.translation: 空のスペーサーを外すと、保護を損なわず容積を減らせる場合があります。商品の形を維持する硬い箱を外すのは別の判断です。元の保護を何で補うか確認し、カード、ストラップ、包装紙、付属品のどれを残すか明示します。重量よりサイズが問題なら、元箱を捨てれば経路が変わると考えず、完成後の最長辺を確かめます。

corrections.source: Before accepting the packing result
corrections.translation: 梱包結果を受け入れる前に

corrections.source: Compare the warehouse's confirmed instructions with the quote, the selected content list and any submitted measurement request. If an item has been removed from the parcel, update your old comparison. Keep the record of what was requested separate from what was observed. A final packed weight is evidence of the weight; it does not reveal whether a delicate edge was padded internally.
corrections.translation: 倉庫が受け付けた指示と見積もり、選んだ中身、採寸依頼を照合します。荷物から品物を抜いたら以前の比較を更新してください。依頼内容と目で確認できた結果は別に残します。最終重量が判明しても、傷みやすい縁に内側からクッションを当てたかまでは分かりません。

corrections.source: Imagine a rigid accessory case and two soft shirts. The accessory case has a latch that should not bear pressure. In arrangement A, all three items sit in one tight carton with the shirts around the case. In arrangement B, the case has a separate padded sleeve within a larger outer box. Ask what protection each service actually supplies and whether the packed dimensions are confirmed or estimated. The second arrangement can provide different protection while also changing the available freight route.
corrections.translation: 硬いアクセサリーケースとシャツ2枚を送るとします。ケースの留め具には圧力をかけられません。Aは小さめの箱でシャツをケースに沿わせ、Bは内側にクッション付きの袋を加えて大きめの外箱に入れます。具体的な保護内容と、外寸が実測か概算かを尋ねます。Bは保護だけでなく利用できる配送方法も変えるかもしれません。

corrections.source: Suppose the live representative figures you write down for an illustrative exercise are 130 for freight and 4 for the basic packing in A, compared with 136 for freight and 11 for the more protective service in B. The totals are 134 and 147. The extra cost of B is 13, consisting of six more in freight and seven more in selected packing. If the 136 already includes the protective service, the calculation changes. The wording of the line matters as much as the numbers, which are fictional and do not describe HubBuy's price list.
corrections.translation: 仮にAの運賃は130、普通梱包は4で計134、Bの運賃は136、追加保護が11で計147とします。Bの追加支出13の内訳は運賃6と梱包7です。ところが136に保護がすでに含まれるなら計算は変わります。数字と一緒に項目説明も確かめます。この例の金額はHubBuyの実際の料金表ではありません。

corrections.source: Decide what information is worth obtaining
corrections.translation: 決定に影響する情報を絞る

corrections.source: Before asking a warehouse to prepare two complete alternatives, identify which uncertainty drives your decision. If keeping a retail carton is essential, comparing a box-free arrangement wastes time. If a route has a maximum outer dimension, the useful question may be whether the existing carton fits once protection is added. If the estimator shows a result for only one product category, clarify route acceptance for all contents instead of treating cheap packing as the deciding factor.
corrections.translation: 2案を実際に試すよう頼む前に、何が判断を左右するか考えます。元箱が必須なら、元箱なしの試算には意味がありません。外寸上限があるなら、保護を加えた状態で今の箱が収まるかが重要です。見積もりが1つの商品区分でしか出ない場合は、安い梱包を選ぶ前に、すべての中身がその配送方法で送れるか確かめてください。

corrections.source: Ask about any service charge for a change or for obtaining additional measurements. Do not assume that an alternative packing arrangement can be trialled, reversed and photographed without cost. Record what the account actually offers. A sensible short message identifies the current parcel, the protection that must remain and the measurement you need. For example, a buyer could ask whether the shortest eligible box that retains the protective insert will stay below a stated route limit. A useful answer concerns that precise plan.
corrections.translation: 変更や追加採寸の料金も確認します。試し梱包、元に戻す作業、写真撮影がすべて無料だとは限りません。実際に提供される作業を控え「この荷物で保護インサートを残す場合、使える最短の箱は指定された上限内に収まりますか」と、荷物番号、維持したい保護、必要な測定を具体的に伝えます。

corrections.source: Recognize when cost per kilogram is the wrong measure
corrections.translation: 1 kg当たりの料金だけでは判断しにくい場合

corrections.source: Separate removable packaging from essential components
corrections.translation: 捨てられる包装と商品に必要な部品を区別する

corrections.source: A cloth bag inside a box might be disposable packing, a dust cover included with the merchandise or a separately paid accessory. Specify which you mean before asking for removal. Where several items carry loose parts, list the pieces that must remain together. Save the original option description if the item's completeness or potential return depends on a particular pouch or box. If the identity of a component is unclear, request clarification before allowing disposal.
corrections.translation: 箱の中の布袋は、使い捨て包装、商品付属の保存袋、別料金のアクセサリーのいずれかかもしれません。処分依頼では対象を特定します。付属品が複数ある場合は、一緒に保管する部品を列挙しましょう。返品や商品構成が特定の袋や箱に依存するなら、元の仕様説明を保存します。分からない部品は処分を許可する前に確認してください。

corrections.source: A useful packing record can be short. Write one line per item stating retain, remove or ask, followed by the physical object concerned. For example, retain the protective insert around the handle, remove the empty seller dispatch carton if permitted, and ask before discarding the outer retail box. This makes the instruction understandable even when two boxes have similar dimensions. It also helps you interpret a photograph of the contents before sealing.
corrections.translation: 指示は短くても構いません。各品物で「残す・外す・要確認」と対象物を1行にします。例えば、持ち手周りの保護材は残し、許可されるなら店が送った空の輸送箱は処分、商品の外箱は捨てる前に確認、と書きます。同じ大きさの箱が2つあっても識別しやすく、封をする前の写真とも照合できます。

corrections.source: Compare the result with the instruction
corrections.translation: 作業結果を依頼内容と照合する

corrections.source: Three lengths and one weight are useful only if they describe the same finished box. Measure in the units the estimator expects and record how you obtained each number.
corrections.translation: 縦・横・高さと重量は、同じ梱包済みの荷物を測った値でそろえます。見積もり画面が求める単位に合わせ、各数値の測定方法を残してください。

corrections.source: Identify the parcel being measured
corrections.translation: 測定する荷物を特定する

corrections.source: Capture the largest outer spans
corrections.translation: 突起を含む最大の外寸を測る

corrections.source: Keep the scale reading in the right unit
corrections.translation: はかりの単位を確かめる

corrections.source: The HubBuy form asks for grams. A reading of 1.45 kilograms is 1,450 grams; a reading of 145 grams is an entirely different parcel. Include the packaging and contents on the scale together. A seller's weight for one unit multiplied by the number ordered gives only an initial idea. The finished carton, protection and any original boxes can change the final figure.
corrections.translation: HubBuyのフォームが求めるのはグラムです。はかりの1.45 kgは1450 gで、145 gとは10倍違います。荷物と梱包材を一緒にはかってください。店が示した商品1点の重さを個数倍しても目安にすぎず、発送箱、保護材、残した元箱が加われば最終重量は変わります。

corrections.source: Understand what volume tells you
corrections.translation: 体積から読み取れること

corrections.source: Recheck after the final modification
corrections.translation: 最後に梱包を変更したらもう一度測る

corrections.source: Adding a corner protector or moving an item into another carton can change a dimension even when the overall weight scarcely moves. Keep one dated measurement record for each arrangement. A photograph showing a tape around the box's perimeter cannot establish the three separate side lengths on its own. If one figure looks implausible, ask to see the measurement from start to end before submitting numbers to the calculator.
corrections.translation: 角を保護したり別の箱に移したりすると、総重量がほぼ同じでも寸法が変わります。各案に日付付きの測定記録を残してください。箱を一周するメジャーの写真だけでは3辺それぞれの長さは分かりません。不自然な数値があれば、計算機に入れる前に両端が見える写真を依頼します。

corrections.source: A dimensional comparison you can reproduce
corrections.translation: 内寸と外寸を比較する例

corrections.source: The two numbers answer different questions. Internal volume helps you reason about what might fit. External volume describes the space the packed box occupies. For a route comparison based on outer dimensions, keep the latter. The percentage change in geometric volume is about 21 percent, yet it would be a mistake to predict a 21 percent change in freight. The current route defines the billing method and restrictions. A volume comparison is a measurement exercise, not a complete price calculation.
corrections.translation: 内側の体積は中に何が入るか、外側の体積は梱包後にどれだけ場所を取るかを考える指標です。外寸を使う配送方法の比較では後者を使います。例では体積が約21％増えても、送料も21％上がるとは限りません。計算方法や利用上限は個々の配送条件によります。

corrections.source: Handling soft and irregular shapes
corrections.translation: 柔らかい荷物や不規則な形を測る

corrections.source: Comparing two readings from different people
corrections.translation: 測定者によって数値が違う場合

corrections.source: Protecting the unit conversion
corrections.translation: 単位の取り違えを防ぐ

corrections.source: Create three input fields whose names include cm, then a separate weight field labelled g. If your scale reports ounces or pounds, convert before entering the number and retain the original reading beside the converted value. For a conversion from kilograms, a simple check is to divide the entered grams by 1,000 and confirm you recover your starting reading. A suspiciously tiny value should prompt a unit check before a search for cheaper routes.
corrections.translation: 各寸法欄にはcm、重量欄にはgと明記します。はかりがオンスやポンドなら、換算前と換算後の値を両方残してください。kgをgに換算した場合は、入力した数値を1000で割って元のkg表示に戻るか確認できます。極端に小さな重量が出たら、安い配送方法を探す前に単位を確かめましょう。

corrections.source: Retaining measurements that remain useful
corrections.translation: 後から再利用できる測定記録

corrections.source: When the box has already left the warehouse
corrections.translation: 荷物がすでに出庫した場合

corrections.source: Once the parcel has been dispatched, use the dimensions listed on the actual parcel record for reconciliation. A later measurement taken after the box has been opened or flattened describes a different condition. If you question a recorded dimension, save the label and photographs of the unopened parcel before changing its shape.
corrections.translation: 出庫後に照合するなら、実際の発送記録にある寸法を使います。開封した箱や折り畳んだ箱は、発送時とは別の状態です。記録された外寸を確認したい場合は、箱の形を変える前に配送ラベルを保存し、未開封の状態で写真を撮ってください。

corrections.source: A combined shipment is worth comparing when it remains eligible for a suitable route and protects every item. Price the entire alternative, including every box, before acting on a single attractive quote.
corrections.translation: 同梱は、希望の配送方法を使えて全品の保護を維持できるときに検討できます。1箱分だけの安い金額で選ばず、別送案もすべての箱を含めた総額で比べます。

corrections.source: Start with the same list on both sides
corrections.translation: 同じ内容品から2案を作る

corrections.source: Write the warehouse identifiers and quantities for all items under consideration. Copy that list before building your two scenarios. In the combined option, assign all selected items to one box. In the split option, assign each item to exactly one of two boxes. Check the totals: a missing accessory can make a split option appear artificially cheap, while a duplicated garment makes it seem expensive.
corrections.translation: 比較するすべての入庫番号と数量を記入し、リストを複製します。同梱案では全品を1箱に、別送案では各品を必ずどちらか1箱だけに割り当てます。小物の記入漏れは別送案を実際より安く、服の二重計上は高く見せるので、個数を照合します。

corrections.source: Establish why splitting might help
corrections.translation: 分割する目的を決める

corrections.source: Perhaps only one item needs a rigid box, one piece must go to a different address, or a category affects route eligibility. Those are practical differences worth recording. If the two boxes go to different countries, you are evaluating a different delivery plan, not simply a cheaper arrangement for the same destination. Keep any urgency or special handling requirement visible alongside money.
corrections.translation: 一部だけ硬い箱が必要、1点だけ別住所に送る、品目で配送方法の可否が変わる、などの事情を明記します。2箱が違う国に向かうなら、単に同じ目的地への送料を比べる話ではありません。必要な時期や特別な取り扱いも金額と並べてください。

corrections.source: Compare the full international cost
corrections.translation: 国際発送の総額を比較する

corrections.source: Check whether the estimates remain eligible
corrections.translation: 配送条件を各案で満たしているか確認する

corrections.source: Use each box's own actual or proposed outer dimensions, weight and product category. If the combined package exceeds a route limit, strike out that route for that scenario. Never substitute the lighter box's weight for the combined box simply to obtain a result. Compare realistic packing arrangements and check that the selected service accepts all contents, including components that might be easy to forget in an accessory pocket.
corrections.translation: 箱ごとの実測値または予定の外寸・重量・品目で見積もります。同梱したらサイズ上限を超える場合、その案では当該経路を外します。結果表示のために軽い箱の重量を同梱箱に流用しないでください。付属品ポケットの中身を含め、実際の梱包案で全品を引き受けてもらえるかを確認します。

corrections.source: Make a decision you can audit
corrections.translation: 選んだ理由を記録する

corrections.source: Write the reason for the choice in ordinary language. It might be that the cheaper combined service satisfies all requirements, or that paying more for two boxes lets the urgent item leave before a later intake. Save the estimated difference separately from the eventual outcome. Once both parcels have been billed, compare each final entry against the estimate for the correct arrangement and explain any changed input.
corrections.translation: 「安い同梱で保護条件を満たせる」「別送は高いが遅い商品の入庫前に急ぎの品を出せる」など、理由を短く書きます。予想した差額と最終結果は別に残します。2箱とも請求が出たら、各箱に対応する案と金額を照合し、条件が変わった部分を示します。

corrections.source: An example where the larger box wins
corrections.translation: 大きな1箱が適する例

corrections.source: An example where smaller boxes remain worth considering
corrections.translation: 小さい2箱にも利点がある例

corrections.source: How placement changes the measurement
corrections.translation: 入れ方による寸法の違い

corrections.source: The estimated split arrangement deserves the same care. A padded case may fit into one small carton, while the garments can use another shape. Give each box its intended packing and dimensions. Using a generous measured combined box alongside separate dimensions guessed from bare product photographs biases the result against consolidation. State the quality of your evidence for both scenarios. If a decision turns on a small difference, obtaining equivalent measurements can matter more than refining the arithmetic.
corrections.translation: 別送でも同じ基準を使います。保護ケースは小さな箱、衣類は別形状の箱になるかもしれません。各箱の梱包と外寸を明示します。同梱は余裕を見た実測の箱、別送は裸の商品写真からの推測では同梱に不利です。どの程度確かな値かを両案で示し、差が小さいときは同等の測定を優先しましょう。

corrections.source: Organizing decisions around timing
corrections.translation: 発送時期から判断する

corrections.source: A buyer might have one item already checked and another still waiting for a seller response. The combined quote assumes both will become eligible for shipment together. Record what you know about the later item and the storage status of the earlier one. A decision to split can address timing even if the combined quote has a small price advantage. State the timing requirement separately, for example that one item must leave before another has been inspected.
corrections.translation: 1点は検品済みでも、もう1点は店からの返答待ちという場合があります。同梱見積もりは両方を一緒に出せる前提です。遅い商品の状況と先に届いた商品の保管期限を記録します。同梱が少し安くても急ぎなら別送に意味があります。「後の商品を検品する前に先の品を出す必要あり」などの条件を別に書きます。

corrections.source: Avoid promising a delivery date on the basis of the number of boxes alone. A route estimate, seller delay, warehouse intake and final delivery can each describe a different stage. If the two pieces are needed as one matching set, splitting also creates a practical risk that one arrives earlier than its partner. If the pieces serve different recipients, the timing difference might be entirely acceptable. The right comparison includes how the items will actually be used.
corrections.translation: 箱数だけでは到着日は約束できません。店の遅れ、倉庫受け入れ、発送後の所要日数、最終配達は別の段階です。セットで使う2点の別送では片方だけ先に届くかもしれません。受取人が違えば到着のずれを問題にしないこともあります。実際の使い方を比較条件に含めます。

corrections.source: Verify the plan after the warehouse acts
corrections.translation: 倉庫作業後に内容を照合する

corrections.source: Once a packing decision has been confirmed, compare the assigned item list with the original scenario. Check that any separate accessory travelled with its intended parent item. In a split shipment, label the two parcel records clearly enough that the first delivery does not accidentally close the second. Keep the tracking number and payment for each box together. A notification about a single parcel can otherwise be mistaken for completion of the entire purchase.
corrections.translation: 梱包が確定したら出荷品リストと元の配分を合わせ、付属品が対応する本体と同じ箱か確認します。別送では各箱の入出金と追跡番号をひとまとめにし、1箱目の配達通知で2箱目まで完了にしないよう、記録にはっきり区別を付けます。

corrections.source: When the actual charges arrive, compare them with the quote for the same configuration. If the courier or route differs, document that change before calculating a saving or overrun. Add the final charges for all boxes in the split option before stating its cost. The result becomes a useful comparison for this shipment. Retain the measured details with it rather than generalizing that consolidation, or splitting, will always be cheaper for a future order.
corrections.translation: 実際の請求は同じ構成の見積もりと比べます。配送会社や経路が変わったら、その変更を記録してから増減を計算します。別送はすべての箱の最終料金を合算します。実測寸法も残し、今回どちらが安かったかを説明してください。別の買い物でも常に同梱または別送がお得とは限りません。

corrections.source: If one box will go directly to another person, include the cost and feasibility of forwarding an item locally under the combined arrangement. Compare delivery to both intended recipients, not simply delivery to the first address. Record which additional domestic leg is confirmed and which is hypothetical before making a claim about total savings.
corrections.translation: 片方の箱を別の人へ直接送るなら、同梱案では最初の受取人から現地で転送する費用と可否も考えます。比較の到達点は最初の住所ではなく両者の手元です。追加の国内区間で確認済みの費用と仮定を区別してから、総額でどれだけ節約できるかを述べます。

corrections.source: Read a freight result as a quotation for a named parcel, route and destination. Use it to answer the transport question it was calculated for, then check the remaining parts of your purchase separately.
corrections.translation: 運賃表示は、指定した荷物、配送方法、配送先に対する見積もりです。その条件の輸送費を判断するために使い、購入費用の残りの部分は別途確かめましょう。

corrections.source: Read the inputs before the result
corrections.translation: 結果を読む前に入力条件を確認する

corrections.source: The HubBuy estimator accepts a destination and weight in grams and provides fields for product category and centimetre dimensions. An estimate based on a preset hoodie and one based on a measured packed box describe different evidence. Record which you used. A result without its inputs is difficult to reuse because you may later forget whether it covered a single garment or the full shipment.
corrections.translation: HubBuyの計算機では配送先と重量をgで入力し、商品カテゴリーと寸法をcmで指定できます。既定のパーカーの値で試す場合と、梱包済みの実箱をはかる場合では根拠が違います。使った条件を残してください。結果だけだと、後で1着分か荷物全体か分からなくなります。

corrections.source: Build an inclusion list
corrections.translation: 料金に含まれるものを表にする

corrections.source: Compare timing on the same basis
corrections.translation: 同じ時点から数えた所要日数を比べる

corrections.source: A delivery estimate may refer to a stage starting at dispatch. Read the route description before promising someone a date based on it. Include unresolved purchasing, seller dispatch, warehouse intake or packing in a separate planning timeline. Avoid adding arbitrary days to manufacture a confident arrival date. If the use date matters, state which pending event creates uncertainty and check the latest confirmed status.
corrections.translation: 日数の目安が発送後から始まる場合があります。その数字で到着日を約束する前に配送条件を読んでください。購入手続き、店の出荷待ち、入庫、梱包は別の予定表で管理します。根拠なく日数を足すより、使用期限に影響する未確定の工程と最新の確認状況を示しましょう。

corrections.source: Recheck destination details privately
corrections.translation: 住所情報を公開せずに配送先を確認する

corrections.source: Mark the boundary of the estimate with an example
corrections.translation: どこまでが見積額かを数字で区別する

corrections.source: Imagine a buyer who has a confirmed merchandise total of 280 yuan, a domestic delivery charge of 12 and a screen showing an illustrative international freight estimate of 135. The cost recorded so far is 427, provided the freight estimate holds and there are no other separately applied charges. The 135 is not the price of the entire purchase. Equally, adding the 280 and 12 again to a consolidated budget that already includes those entries would overstate the amount.
corrections.translation: 確定商品代280元、国内送料12、国際運賃の見込み135とします。見込みどおりで別料金がなければ、今分かる合計は427です。135は購入全体の代金ではありません。反対に、280と12をすでに含む購入予算にもう一度加えても過大になります。

corrections.source: Suppose the buyer keeps a separate running budget containing 292 already paid. To evaluate cash still needed, start with the prospective 135 and any other unpaid components that can be documented. To evaluate the total cost of acquiring and receiving the goods, include paid and unpaid components. Both calculations are valid, but they answer different questions. Label the output remaining payment or total purchase budget rather than presenting a single unexplained figure.
corrections.translation: すでに292を支払い済みと記入した予算があるなら、「これから必要なお金」は未払いの135と、確認できたその他の未払い費用から考えます。「買って手元に届くまでの総額」には支払済み分も入ります。同じ買い物でも違う問いなので、「残りの支払予定額」か「総購入予算」かを明示してください。

corrections.source: Compare two routes on one parcel
corrections.translation: 同じ荷物で配送方法を2つ比較する

corrections.source: A route summary can show an estimated duration, price and brief notes, while a detail page may describe eligibility and service conditions. For a fair comparison, run both routes against the same parcel. Keep the destination, category, weight, outer dimensions, packing and declared contents consistent. Check what the figures include and whether one service shown in the summary becomes a separate charge later. If a route does not accept the contents, remove it from the usable comparison.
corrections.translation: 配送一覧には日数、価格、短い注意書きのみで、引き受け条件や提供内容は詳細ページにあることがあります。配送先、品目、重量、外寸、梱包と申告内容をそろえて2案を計算します。表示額に含まれる作業と後で別請求になる作業を確認してください。内容物を引き受けない配送方法は比較候補から外します。

corrections.source: In a teaching exercise, route A displays 150 and route B displays 166. If A requires a separately quoted 12-unit service that B includes, the comparable amounts are 162 and 166. If B includes something you do not need and A needs nothing additional, the original 150 and 166 may be the relevant comparison. The example does not represent a real HubBuy route or a real price. Its purpose is to show why a service description can change which arithmetic belongs beside the price.
corrections.translation: 例として、経路Aが150、Bが166と表示されています。Aだけに必要な別作業12があり、Bには含まれていれば、比べるべき金額は162と166です。Bに付く作業は不要でAに追加もなければ、150と166を使えます。これはHubBuyの実在経路や実料金ではなく、サービス内容で足し算が変わることを示す例です。

corrections.source: Translate uncertain components into clear questions
corrections.translation: 未確定の項目を具体的な質問にする

corrections.source: Use a short list with four statuses: included, already paid separately, confirmed additional cost, and unknown. Place each disputed component into one category only. For example, if an invoice confirms payment of domestic delivery with the seller order, do not also treat it as an unknown outbound fee. If the estimator does not explain how a particular optional service is handled, record the uncertainty beside that service.
corrections.translation: 各項目を「込み」「別途支払済み」「追加額確定」「不明」のどれか1つに分類します。店の注文で国内送料を支払った請求書があるなら、同じ額を国際発送時の未確定費用にも入れないようにします。任意の作業が含まれるか見積もりに説明がない場合、その作業にだけ「未確認」と付けます。

corrections.source: Use actual parcel changes to explain an apparent price change
corrections.translation: 荷物の変更と見かけの値上がりを照合する

corrections.source: The buyer may initially quote a single pair of shoes using a quick-estimate preset. Later the seller's box is retained, then a belt is added before international submission. The resulting packed measurements no longer describe the same shipment as the preset. Compare the revised quote with the final parcel statement, while keeping the original as evidence of how the budget developed. A difference between the first and last amounts is not automatically a new fee.
corrections.translation: 最初は靴1足の既定値で概算した後、元の靴箱を残し、さらにベルトを同梱する場合があります。完成後の荷物は元の概算とは条件が違います。新しい条件での見積もりを最終明細と比べ、初回の値は予算の経緯として残します。最初と最後の差額がすべて追加手数料とは限りません。

corrections.source: If you want to learn which change drove the difference, vary one input at a time in your own planning worksheet, provided the estimator supports the comparison. Keep the original destination and category, replace the assumed weight with the packed weight and record the result. Then apply the new dimensions. Label intermediate results as analytical scenarios rather than quotes for parcels you intend to send. If package category or eligibility changed, that can invalidate a direct one-input comparison.
corrections.translation: どの変更が効いたか調べる場合、計算機が対応していれば一度に1つだけ入力を変えます。配送先とカテゴリーを維持して見込み重量を実測に直し、次に新しい寸法を入れます。途中の結果には比較用の試算と明記し、その条件で実際に送る見積もりと区別します。品目や利用資格が変わる場合、1条件だけの直接比較が成り立たないこともあります。

corrections.source: Hand the result to another buyer clearly
corrections.translation: 別の購入者にも再現できる形で伝える

corrections.source: When the parcel is ready, revisit the paragraph. Replace assumed measurements with confirmed ones, check that the route still appears and compare the actual payment request with the latest estimate. If an input is still provisional, say so before approving the expense. Keep the final payment record for reconciliation. The value of an estimate is its ability to support a decision under specified conditions, not its ability to guarantee a number after those conditions have changed.
corrections.translation: 荷物が準備できたらメモを見直し、仮の寸法を確定値に直します。経路がまだ選べるか、支払依頼が最新の見積もりと合うか確認してください。暫定条件が残るなら支払い前に明記し、最終決済を照合用に保存します。見積もりは決めた条件で判断するためのもので、その条件が変わった後の価格保証ではありません。

corrections.source: Record who provided each figure
corrections.translation: 各数値の出所を記入する

corrections.source: Put the source beside each amount when the seller, warehouse, and carrier all appear in one comparison. A seller’s approximate packed weight can be enough for an early screening decision. Once a warehouse measurement arrives, retain the seller figure in a separate column so a reader can see why the estimate changed and which measurement supported the eventual booking.
corrections.translation: 店、倉庫、配送会社の数字を一緒に扱うなら、金額や重量の横に提供元を入れます。最初の候補選びには店の概算重量で十分な場合もあります。倉庫で実測できたら店の値を別欄に残すと、どの測定で最終的な出荷を決めたか、見積もりがなぜ変わったかを説明できます。

corrections.source: A good reconciliation tells you where a difference first appeared. Work in the original currency and parcel reference before looking at exchange effects or assuming a fee was added.
corrections.translation: 明細を照合するときは、差が初めて生じた箇所を探します。まず元通貨と同じ荷物番号で比較し、為替や新しい手数料の可能性は後から検討します。

corrections.source: Reconstruct the original comparison
corrections.translation: 最初の比較条件を再現する

corrections.source: Gather the original estimate, the warehouse submission and the final payment record. Confirm they refer to the same parcel contents and destination. A quote for two garments and a bill for two garments plus a box of shoes cannot be explained by checking the arithmetic alone. Keep the old list visible and make a separate column for the list eventually sent.
corrections.translation: 初回の見積もり、倉庫への発送指示、最終決済をそろえ、中身と配送先が一致するか確認します。服2着の見積もりと、服2着に靴箱を加えた請求の差は足し算だけでは説明できません。元の内容リストを残し、実際に送ったリストを隣の欄に記入します。

corrections.source: Compare physical inputs before money
corrections.translation: 金額の前に荷物の条件を比較する

corrections.source: Write the initial and final weight beside the initial and final outer dimensions. Record which inputs came from product presets, seller figures, proposed packing or an actual completed parcel. Put the route and service choice on the same row. If the original option disappeared because of a size limit, compare the final route's charge with a revised quote for that route rather than blaming every difference on the weight change.
corrections.translation: 最初と最後の重量・外寸を並べ、既定値、店の数字、試算した梱包、実測のどれかを示します。経路とサービスも同じ行に記録します。サイズ上限で当初の方式を使えなくなったら、実際に使った経路の新しい見積もりと比べます。すべてを重量変化のせいにしないでください。

corrections.source: Separate displayed totals from independent charges
corrections.translation: 合計表示と別途加える料金を区別する

corrections.source: Imagine that an estimated 140 rises to a final debit of 168. A final statement shows base freight of 156 and packing of 12. The first 16 of the difference comes from the freight line, and the remaining 12 is the packing line. The reconstructed final amount is 168. Do not sum 168, 156 and 12: the total already contains the two components.
corrections.translation: 見込み140に対して最終引き落としが168とします。明細が基本運賃156と梱包12なら、元の見込みとの差は運賃の増額16と梱包12です。156 + 12で168を再現できます。168、156、12をすべて足さないでください。168にはすでに2項目が入っています。

corrections.source: Reconcile the payment destination
corrections.translation: どの手段からいくら支払ったかを照合する

corrections.source: A coupon, account credit or refund can change the amount paid from an external card without changing the invoice subtotal. Record invoice total, balance used, external payment and credits as separate fields. When converting to your home currency, keep the original values intact and state the rate or posted amount used. If a promised credit has not posted, label it as pending instead of deducting it from the confirmed payment history.
corrections.translation: クーポン、アカウント残高、返金により、請求書の小計が変わらなくてもカード負担は変わり得ます。請求総額、利用残高、外部決済、返金を別欄に記載します。自国通貨表示には元の数値と使用したレートまたは実際の記帳額を残し、約束された返金が未着なら支払実績から引かず保留にします。

corrections.source: Ask one question with the relevant evidence
corrections.translation: 証拠を付けて差額を1件ずつ尋ねる

corrections.source: If a difference remains, identify the charge and both records where you expected it to match. For example, ask which input changed the base freight between a named quote and a named parcel. Include the route, measurement date and currency, and omit unrelated payment details. HubBuy's public support page lists parcel submission, orders and shipping among its support topics. Use that channel for an explanation specific to your account.
corrections.translation: 説明できない場合、どの料金がどの2つの記録で一致するはずだったかを示します。見積番号と小包番号を挙げ、どの条件で基本運賃が変わったか尋ねましょう。経路、測定日、通貨を添え、無関係な決済情報は省きます。HubBuyの公開サポートには発送手続き、注文、配送などの項目があります。個別アカウントの質問はその窓口で確認します。

corrections.source: A complete fictional reconciliation
corrections.translation: 架空の明細を最後まで照合する

corrections.source: Suppose the planning sheet contains an old seller subtotal of 220, domestic delivery of 10 and an outbound estimate of 145. The initial overall figure is 375. During packing the buyer adds a separately purchased accessory. Its purchase and domestic movement have already been recorded elsewhere. The outbound box also changes: the final freight line is 153 and the packing service line is 9. The new outbound total is 162. Comparing 162 with 145 gives a 17-unit change on the parcel side.
corrections.translation: 初回の予算が店の商品小計220、国内送料10、国際運賃見込み145で合計375だったとします。梱包時に別途購入したアクセサリーを追加しました。その商品代と国内送料は別の注文で記録済みです。外箱も変わり、最終の基本運賃153と梱包9で国際分は162。145との差は国際発送部分だけで17です。

corrections.source: That 17 consists of eight more in the freight line and nine in the selected service under these example assumptions. It does not measure the cost of the accessory itself and should not be compared with the earlier all-purchase total of 375. Add the accessory's actual purchase entries separately if the question is total cost for the entire basket. Keep the same currency and identify whether any discount applies to freight, merchandise or the charge as a whole. The purpose is to reach an explanation for every difference without counting anything twice.
corrections.translation: この17の内訳は運賃の増分8と追加作業9で、アクセサリーそのものの代金は含みません。当初の商品代込み375とは直接比較できません。カート全体を問う場合は、別に記録したアクセサリーの実際の費用を加えます。通貨をそろえ、割引が商品・運賃・全体のどれにかかるか確認し、各差額を重複なく説明します。

corrections.source: Distinguish invoice totals from sources of payment
corrections.translation: 請求額と支払原資は別の記録

corrections.source: Imagine the final parcel invoice is 162, the buyer uses 20 of account credit and the external card supplies the remaining 142. Checking only the card account might make the shipment look cheaper than it was. The invoice total still describes 162 of parcel charges. The payment history shows how that amount was settled. Record both pieces of information instead of replacing the invoice total with the smaller card debit.
corrections.translation: 請求額162のうち20はアカウント残高、残り142はカードで払ったとします。カードだけ見ると本当の発送費用を過小評価します。請求総額は162で、支払い履歴はその額をどの手段で払ったかを示します。小さいカードの記帳額で請求総額を上書きしないでください。

corrections.source: The distinction also matters after a refund. Suppose six units are returned to the account balance later. Preserve the original 162 invoice, the original combination of payments and the separate six-unit credit with its destination. You can calculate a net cost when the refund is confirmed. If it has merely been requested, keep it in a pending column. That way one person reviewing the sheet for available funds and another reviewing it for net cost can both understand the figures.
corrections.translation: 後から6がアカウント残高に戻っても、元の請求162と支払手段の内訳を維持し、返金6と返金先を別行にします。入金が確定したら正味の費用を計算し、申請しただけなら保留欄に置きます。利用可能な残高を調べる人と、最終支出を確かめる人の両方が数字を追えます。

corrections.source: Account for a route change before comparing rates
corrections.translation: 経路の変更を確認してから運賃を比べる

corrections.source: If the originally chosen route could not take the final parcel, compare the final statement with an estimate for the route that was actually used. Keep the old option separately and note why it became unavailable if the platform supplies a reason. A rate difference between two routes does not prove an unexpected change in the price of either route. Likewise, a change of destination or declared category can produce a different service set before weight and volume are even considered.
corrections.translation: 元の経路では完成した荷物を引き受けられなかったら、実際に使った経路の見積もりを最終明細と比べます。元の案も残し、利用できなくなった理由が示されていれば記録します。違う経路の価格差だけでは、どちらかの経路が値上がりした証拠にはなりません。配送先や申告区分の変更で、重量や体積以前に選択可能なサービスが変わることもあります。

corrections.source: Build a one-line contents list for each final parcel and match each original item exactly once. Identify excluded, returned or later-added items. If the contents have changed substantially, also retain a separate estimate calculated for the revised two-box arrangement. This new comparison is often better for checking the final charge, while the original estimate remains useful for understanding why the shopping plan exceeded the initial budget.
corrections.translation: 最終的な箱ごとに内容を1行で記し、元の品物を各1回だけ割り当てます。除外、返品、後から入れた物は識別します。内容が大きく変わった場合、新しい2個口案でも見積もりを残してください。最終請求を調べるには新しい条件、当初予算を超えた経緯を説明するには元の条件が役立ちます。

corrections.source: Decide whether the remaining difference is actionable
corrections.translation: 残る差額を問い合わせるべきか判断する

corrections.source: A small difference can come from rounding after currency conversion. It can also identify a real missing service line. Reconstruct the original-currency amounts first. Check whether rounding at the invoice level instead of at the item level accounts for the difference. If both the currency and all inputs match and a residual remains, do not create an unnamed miscellaneous charge just to make the sheet total agree. Preserve the residual and ask about it.
corrections.translation: 小さなずれは換算後の丸めでも起こりますが、実在するサービス行の漏れかもしれません。まず元通貨で計算し直し、個別商品で丸めた場合と請求合計で丸めた場合を比べます。通貨も条件も一致してなお残れば、帳尻を合わせるために「雑費」を作らず、差額そのものを残して問い合わせます。

corrections.source: Send a message containing the parcel reference, original quote date, input measurements, final amount and arithmetic that remains unexplained. If the answer identifies an existing line, correct its classification instead of adding a duplicate. If a new credit is promised, follow it through to the account record. Close the reconciliation when both the invoice composition and the actual payment movements can be traced. Keep the dated comparison with the parcel documents for the next time you budget a similar shipment.
corrections.translation: 小包番号、最初の見積日、入力した寸法・重量、最終金額、説明できない算式をまとめます。答えが既存の明細行を指すなら分類を直し、同じ費用を追加しません。新たな返金が約束されたら実際に記帳されるまで追います。請求内訳と資金移動の両方をたどれるようになったら照合を閉じ、日付付きの比較を次回の予算用に保管します。

corrections.source: Keep a readable closing note
corrections.translation: 結論を短く記録する

corrections.source: Write a one-sentence conclusion next to each resolved difference. For example, a previously unexplained charge might match a packing service on an earlier confirmation. Record that confirmation date and amount. Someone checking your records later can follow that connection even if the original transaction description was abbreviated.
corrections.translation: 解決した差額の横に理由を1文添えます。例えば、当初不明だった料金が以前に確認済みの梱包作業と一致したら、その確認日と金額を記録します。元の取引摘要が略称でも、後で見た人が同じ根拠を確認できます。
